title.zh: 卷三十四 本紀第三十四: 文宗三
title.raw: 卷三十四 本紀第三十四: 文宗三 Volume 34 Annals 34: Wenzong 3

sentences.zh: 至順元年春正月丙辰，命趙世延、趙世安領纂修《經世大典》事。

translations.literal: First year of Zhishun, spring, first month, on bingchen day, Zhao Shiyan and Zhao Shi'an were ordered to take charge of compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》.
translations.idiomatic: First year of Zhishun, spring, first month, on bingchen day, Zhao Shiyan and Zhao Shi'an were ordered to take charge of compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》.

sentences.zh: 懷慶路饑，賑鈔四千錠。

translations.literal: Huaiqing Route suffered famine; four thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiqing Route suffered famine; 4,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜明宗妃按出罕、月魯沙、不顏忽魯都鈔幣有差。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Mingzong's consorts Babusha, Yuelusha, and Buyan Khuladu were granted paper currency in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Mingzong's consorts Babusha, Yuelusha, and Buyan Khuladu were granted paper currency in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 以知樞密院事伯帖木兒為遼陽行省左丞相。

translations.literal: Privy council administrator Bertemur was made Liaodong Branch Secretariat left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Bertemur was made Liaodong Branch Secretariat left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 戊午，頒璽書諭雲南。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, sealed edicts were issued instructing Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, sealed edicts were issued instructing Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，時享太廟。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 命回回司天監翙星。

translations.literal: The Huihui Bureau of Astronomy was ordered to chart the stars.
translations.idiomatic: The Huihui Bureau of Astronomy was ordered to chart the stars.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，中興路饑，賑糶糧萬石，貧者仍赒其家。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Zhongxing Route suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain was sold for relief, and the poor were still granted bounty for their households.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Zhongxing Route suffered famine; 10,000 shi of grain was sold for relief, and the poor were still granted bounty for their households.

sentences.zh: 甲子，燕鐵木兒、伯顏並辭丞相職，不允，仍命阿榮、趙世安慰諭之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Yan Temür and Bayan both resigned their chancellor posts; the request was not granted, and Arong and Zhao Shi'an were still ordered to console and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Yan Temür and Bayan both resigned their chancellor posts; the request was not granted, and Arong and Zhao Shi'an were still ordered to console and instruct them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，雲南諸王禿堅及萬戶伯忽、阿禾、怯朝等叛，攻中慶路，陷之，殺廉訪司官，執左丞忻都等，迫令署諸文牘。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Yunnan princes Tujian and wanhu Boqu, Ahe, Qiechao, and others rebelled, attacked Zhongqing Route, and took it; they killed surveillance commission officials, seized left chancellor Xindu and others, and compelled them to sign various documents.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yunnan princes Tujian and wanhu Boqu, Ahe, Qiechao, and others rebelled, attacked Zhongqing Route, and took it; they killed surveillance commission officials, seized left chancellor Xindu and others, and compelled them to sign various documents.

sentences.zh: 庚午，芍陂屯及鷹坊軍士饑，賑糧一月。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Shaoqi garrison and hawkery soldiers suffered famine; one month's grain was granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Shaoqi garrison and hawkery soldiers suffered famine; 1 month's grain was granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，中書省臣言：「科舉會試日期，舊制以二月一日、三日、五日，近歲改為十一、十三、十五。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, central secretariat officials said: "The dates for the civil service examination metropolitan tests — the old regulation fixed them on the first, third, and fifth days of the second month; in recent years this was changed to the eleventh, thirteenth, and fifteenth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, central secretariat officials said: "The dates for the civil service examination metropolitan tests — the old regulation fixed them on the 1st, 3rd, and 5th days of the second month; in recent years this was changed to the 11th, 13th, and 15th.

sentences.zh: 請依舊制。

translations.literal: We request that the old regulation be followed.
translations.idiomatic: We request that the old regulation be followed.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " It was approved.

sentences.zh: 壬申，衡陽徭為寇，劫掠湘鄉州。

translations.literal: Hengyang Yao became bandits and plundered Xiangxiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hengyang Yao became bandits and plundered Xiangxiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以宣徽使撒敦復知樞密院事，與欽察臺並領長寧卿。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, palace ordonnance commissioner Sadon was again made privy council administrator and jointly supervised Changning Commandery with the Qipchaq Office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, palace ordonnance commissioner Sadon was again made privy council administrator and jointly supervised Changning Commandery with the Qipchaq Office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜燕鐵木兒質庫一。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Yan Temür was granted one pawnshop.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yan Temür was granted 1 pawnshop.

sentences.zh: 密海州文登、牟平縣饑，賑以糧三千石。

translations.literal: Wen and Haizhou's Wendeng and Mouping counties suffered famine; three thousand shi of grain was granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Wen and Haizhou's Wendeng and Mouping counties suffered famine; 3,000 shi of grain was granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙子，衡州路饑，總管王伯恭以所受制命質官糧萬石賑之。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Hengzhou Route suffered famine; route superintendent Wang Bogong pawned his commission tally to an official for ten thousand shi of grain to relieve the famine.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Hengzhou Route suffered famine; route superintendent Wang Bogong pawned his commission tally to an official for 10,000 shi of grain to relieve the famine.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，追封三寶奴為郢城王，謚榮敏。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Sanbaonu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Yingcheng, posthumous name Rongmin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Sanbaonu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Yingcheng, posthumous name Rongmin.

sentences.zh: 召荊王之子脫脫木兒赴闕。

translations.literal: The Prince of Jing's son Tuotuomuer was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Jing's son Tuotuomuer was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 趙世延請致仕，不允。

translations.literal: Zhao Shiyan requested retirement; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shiyan requested retirement; the request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 命中書省制玉帶二十，賜臣僚官一品者。

translations.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to make twenty jade belts and grant them to officials of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to make 20 jade belts and grant them to officials of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 遣使賫金千五百兩、銀五百兩，詣杭州書佛經。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched bearing one thousand five hundred taels of gold and five hundred taels of silver to transcribe Buddhist sutras at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched bearing 1,500 taels of gold and 500 taels of silver to transcribe Buddhist sutras at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 賜海南大興龍普明寺鈔萬錠，市永業地。

translations.literal: The Great Xinglong Puming Monastery in Hainan was granted ten thousand ingots of notes to purchase perpetual-tenure land.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Xinglong Puming Monastery in Hainan was granted 10,000 ingots of notes to purchase perpetual-tenure land.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜隆禧總管府田千頃。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, one thousand qing of fields of the Longxi directorate-general were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, 1,000 qing of fields of the Longxi directorate-general were granted.

sentences.zh: 立荊襄等處、平松等處田賦提舉司，並隸太禧宗禋院。

translations.literal: Jingxiang and elsewhere and Pingsong and elsewhere land-tax intendancies were established, both subordinate to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxiang and elsewhere and Pingsong and elsewhere land-tax intendancies were established, both subordinate to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings.

sentences.zh: 命陜西行省以鹽課鈔十萬錠賑流民之復業者。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to use one hundred thousand ingots of salt-tax notes to relieve wandering people returning to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to use 100,000 ingots of salt-tax notes to relieve wandering people returning to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 徭賊八百餘人寇石康縣。

translations.literal: More than eight hundred Yao bandits raided Shikang County.
translations.idiomatic: More than 800 Yao bandits raided Shikang County.

sentences.zh: 己卯，封太醫院使野理牙為秦國公。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Grand Medical Academy director Yeliya was enfeoffed Duke of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Grand Medical Academy director Yeliya was enfeoffed Duke of Qin.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，升群玉署為群玉內司，秩正三品，置司尉、亞尉、僉司、司丞，仍隸奎章閣學士院。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, the Gathered Jade Office was promoted to the Gathered Jade Inner Office, rank 3a; office commandant, deputy commandant, colonel of the office, and office secretary were appointed, still subordinate to the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academician Institute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Gathered Jade Office was promoted to the Gathered Jade Inner Office, rank 3a; office commandant, deputy commandant, colonel of the office, and office secretary were appointed, still subordinate to the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academician Institute.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書飐飐兼監群玉內司事。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Zhanzhan concurrently supervised affairs of the Gathered Jade Inner Office.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Zhanzhan concurrently supervised affairs of the Gathered Jade Inner Office.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，改大都田賦提舉司為宣農提舉司，荊襄田賦提舉司為荊襄濟農香戶提舉司，平江提舉司為平江善農提舉司。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the Dadu land-tax intendancy was renamed the Office for Promoting Agriculture, the Jingxiang land-tax intendancy was renamed the Jingxiang Relief Agriculture Incense Household Intendancy, and the Pingjiang intendancy was renamed the Pingjiang Good Agriculture Intendancy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Dadu land-tax intendancy was renamed the Office for Promoting Agriculture, the Jingxiang land-tax intendancy was renamed the Jingxiang Relief Agriculture Incense Household Intendancy, and the Pingjiang intendancy was renamed the Pingjiang Good Agriculture Intendancy.

sentences.zh: 遣使賫鈔三千錠，往甘肅市髦牛。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched bearing three thousand ingots of notes to Gansu to purchase yak cattle.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched bearing 3,000 ingots of notes to Gansu to purchase yak cattle.

sentences.zh: 濠州去年旱，賑糧一月。

translations.literal: Haozhou suffered drought last year; one month's grain was granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Haozhou suffered drought last year; 1 month's grain was granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 大名路及江浙諸路俱以去年旱告，永平路以去年八月雹災告。

translations.literal: Daming Route and Jiang-Zhe routes all reported drought last year; Yongping Route reported hail disaster last August.
translations.idiomatic: Daming Route and Jiang-Zhe routes all reported drought last year; Yongping Route reported hail disaster last August.

sentences.zh: 加封秦蜀郡太守李冰為聖德廣裕英惠王，其子二郎神為英烈昭惠靈顯仁祐王。

translations.literal: Qin-Shu commandery governor Li Bing was further enfeoffed as King Shengde Guangyu Yinghui; his son Erlang Shen was enfeoffed as King Yinglie Zhaohui Lingxian Renyou.
translations.idiomatic: Qin-Shu commandery governor Li Bing was further enfeoffed as King Shengde Guangyu Yinghui; his son Erlang Shen was enfeoffed as King Yinglie Zhaohui Lingxian Renyou.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午朔，以趙世安為御史中丞，史惟良為中書左丞。

translations.literal: Second month, on renwu new moon, Zhao Shi'an was made supervising censor-in-chief and Shi Weiliang was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on renwu new moon, Zhao Shi'an was made supervising censor-in-chief and Shi Weiliang was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，加知樞密院事燕不鄰開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, privy council administrator Yan Bulin was further granted Palace Secretariat Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, privy council administrator Yan Bulin was further granted Palace Secretariat Grandee.

sentences.zh: 籍張珪子五人家資。

translations.literal: The household assets of Zhang Gui's five sons were registered.
translations.idiomatic: The household assets of Zhang Gui's 5 sons were registered.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以西僧加瓦藏卜、蘸八兒監藏並為烏思藏土蕃等處宣慰使都元帥。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the western monks Gawazangbu and Zanba'r Jianzang were both made pacification commissioners and commander-in-chief of U-Tsang and Tibetan territories.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the western monks Gawazangbu and Zanba'r Jianzang were both made pacification commissioners and commander-in-chief of U-Tsang and Tibetan territories.

sentences.zh: 雲南麓川等土官來貢方物。

translations.literal: Yunnan Lucchuan and other native officials came to present tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Lucchuan and other native officials came to present tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 楊州、安豐、廬州等路饑，以兩淮鹽課鈔五萬錠、糧五萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Yangzhou, Anfeng, Luzhou, and other routes suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of Liang-Huai salt-tax notes and fifty thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou, Anfeng, Luzhou, and other routes suffered famine; 50,000 ingots of Liang-Huai salt-tax notes and 50,000 shi of grain were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 真定、蘄、黃等路，汝寧府、鄭州饑，各賑糧一月。

translations.literal: Zhending, Qi, Huang, and other routes; Runing Prefecture and Zheng Prefecture suffered famine; each was granted one month's grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhending, Qi, Huang, and other routes; Runing Prefecture and Zheng Prefecture suffered famine; each was granted 1 month's grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命江南、陜西、河南等處富民輸粟補官，江南萬石者官正七品，陜西千五百石、河南二千石、江南五千石者從七品，自余品級有差。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, it was ordered that wealthy households in Jiangnan, Shaanxi, Henan, and elsewhere who transported grain might purchase office: in Jiangnan ten thousand shi earned rank 7a, in Shaanxi one thousand five hundred shi, in Henan two thousand shi, and in Jiangnan five thousand shi earned rank 7b, with other amounts graded in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, it was ordered that wealthy households in Jiangnan, Shaanxi, Henan, and elsewhere who transported grain might purchase office: in Jiangnan 10,000 shi earned rank 7a, in Shaanxi 1,500 shi, in Henan 2,000 shi, and in Jiangnan 5,000 shi earned rank 7b, with other amounts graded in rank.

sentences.zh: 四川富民有能輸粟赴江陵者，依河南例，其不願仕，乞封父母者聽。

translations.literal: Sichuan wealthy who could transport grain to Jiangling would follow the Henan precedent; those unwilling to serve but requesting enfeoffment for parents were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan wealthy who could transport grain to Jiangling would follow the Henan precedent; those unwilling to serve but requesting enfeoffment for parents were permitted.

sentences.zh: 僧、道輸己粟者，加以師號。

translations.literal: Monks and Daoists who transported their own grain were given honorific master titles.
translations.idiomatic: Monks and Daoists who transported their own grain were given honorific master titles.

sentences.zh: 征江浙、江西、湖廣賑糶糧價鈔赴京師。

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang relief-sale grain prices in notes were levied and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang relief-sale grain prices in notes were levied and sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禿堅、伯忽等攻陷仁德府，至馬龍州，調八番元帥完澤將八番答剌罕軍千人、順元土軍五百人禦之。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Tujian, Boqu, and others took Rendeh Prefecture; reaching Malong Prefecture, Eight Fan commander-in-chief Wanze led one thousand Eight Fan dalqan troops and five hundred Shun yuan native troops to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Tujian, Boqu, and others took Rendeh Prefecture; reaching Malong Prefecture, Eight Fan commander-in-chief Wanze led 1,000 Eight Fan dalqan troops and 500 Shun yuan native troops to resist them.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，改萬聖祐國、興龍普明、龍翔萬壽三提點所並為營繕都司，秩正四品；

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the three intendancies of Wansheng Youguo, Xinglong Puming, and Longxiang Wanshou were combined into the Construction Directorate-General, rank 4a;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the 3 intendancies of Wansheng Youguo, Xinglong Puming, and Longxiang Wanshou were combined into the Construction Directorate-General, rank 4a;

sentences.zh: 萬安規運、普慶營繕等八提點所並為營繕司，秩正五品。

translations.literal: the eight intendancies including Wan'an Regulation Transport and Puqing Construction were combined into the Construction Directorate, rank 5a.
translations.idiomatic: the 8 intendancies including Wan'an Regulation Transport and Puqing Construction were combined into the Construction Directorate, rank 5a.

sentences.zh: 以修《經世大典》久無成功，專命奎章閣阿鄰帖木兒、忽都魯都兒迷失等譯國言所紀典章為漢語，纂修則趙世延、虞集等，而燕鐵木兒如國史例監修。

translations.literal: Because compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》 had long gone without success, Arin Temür, Qutlugh Durmish, and others of the Kui Zhang Pavilion were solely ordered to translate into Chinese the statutes recorded in the national language, while Zhao Shiyan, Yu Ji, and others would compile; Yan Temür was to supervise compilation as in the National History precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Because compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》 had long gone without success, Arin Temür, Qutlugh Durmish, and others of the Kui Zhang Pavilion were solely ordered to translate into Chinese the statutes recorded in the national language, while Zhao Shiyan, Yu Ji, and others would compile; Yan Temür was to supervise compilation as in the National History precedent.

sentences.zh: 開元路胡裏改萬戶府軍士饑，給糧賑之。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan Route Huligai wanhu household troops suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan Route Huligai wanhu household troops suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以御史臺贓罰鈔萬錠、金千兩、銀五千兩付太禧宗禋院，供祭祀之需。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, ten thousand ingots of censorate fine notes, one thousand taels of gold, and five thousand taels of silver were handed over to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings to supply sacrificial needs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, 10,000 ingots of censorate fine notes, 1,000 taels of gold, and 5,000 taels of silver were handed over to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings to supply sacrificial needs.

sentences.zh: 賜燕鐵木兒給驛璽書，以征其食邑租賦。

translations.literal: Yan Temür was granted relay-station sealed edicts to collect his fief rent and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür was granted relay-station sealed edicts to collect his fief rent and taxes.

sentences.zh: 奎章閣學士忽都魯都兒迷失、撒迪、虞集辭職，詔諭之曰：「昔我祖宗睿知聰明，其於致理之道，自然生知。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Kui Zhang Pavilion academics Qutlugh Durmish, Sadi, and Yu Ji resigned; an edict instructed them: "In former times Our ancestors were wise, perceptive, and intelligent; as for the Way of bringing order, they naturally knew it by innate understanding.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Kui Zhang Pavilion academics Qutlugh Durmish, Sadi, and Yu Ji resigned; an edict instructed them: "In former times Our ancestors were wise, perceptive, and intelligent; as for the Way of bringing order, they naturally knew it by innate understanding.

sentences.zh: 朕以統緒所傳，實在眇躬，夙夜憂懼，自惟早歲跋涉艱阻，視我祖宗，既乏生知之明，於國家治體，豈能周知？

translations.literal: We, having received the succession upon this insignificant person, worry day and night; reflecting on Our early years of hardship and toil compared with Our ancestors, We lack their innate understanding — how can We thoroughly know the governing principles of the state?
translations.idiomatic: We, having received the succession upon this insignificant person, worry day and night; reflecting on Our early years of hardship and toil compared with Our ancestors, We lack their innate understanding — how can We thoroughly know the governing principles of the state?

sentences.zh: 故立奎章閣，置學士員，日以祖宗明訓、古昔治亂得失陳說於前，使朕樂於聽聞。

translations.literal: Therefore the Kui Zhang Pavilion was established and academicians appointed, daily expounding before Us Our ancestors' enlightened instructions and the gains and losses of governance in antiquity, that We might delight in hearing them.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Kui Zhang Pavilion was established and academicians appointed, daily expounding before Us Our ancestors' enlightened instructions and the gains and losses of governance in antiquity, that We might delight in hearing them.

sentences.zh: 卿等其推所學以稱朕意，其勿復辭。

translations.literal: You and others should apply your learning to accord with Our intent, and do not resign again.
translations.idiomatic: You and others should apply your learning to accord with Our intent, and do not resign again.

sentences.zh: 」帖麥赤驛戶及建康、廣德、鎮江諸路饑，賑糧一月。

translations.literal: " Temürchi relay households and Jiankang, Guangde, Zhenjiang, and other routes suffered famine; one month's grain was granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: " Temürchi relay households and Jiankang, Guangde, Zhenjiang, and other routes suffered famine; 1 month's grain was granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 衛輝、江州二路饑，賑鈔二萬錠。

translations.literal: Weihui and Jiangzhou two routes suffered famine; twenty thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Weihui and Jiangzhou 2 routes suffered famine; 20,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 寧國路饑，嘗賑糧二萬石，不足，復賑萬五千石。

translations.literal: Ningguo Route suffered famine; twenty thousand shi of grain had been granted for relief, which was insufficient, and fifteen thousand shi more were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguo Route suffered famine; 20,000 shi of grain had been granted for relief, which was insufficient, and 15,000 shi more were granted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，衛輝路胙城、新鄉縣大風雨災。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Weihui Route's Zuocheng and Xinxiang counties suffered great wind and rain disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Weihui Route's Zuocheng and Xinxiang counties suffered great wind and rain disaster.

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, from gengyin to this day, the capital suffered heavy frost and excessive daytime rain.

sentences.zh: 立諸色民匠打捕鷹坊都總管府，秩正二品。

translations.idiomatic: The Directorate-General for All Categories of Artisans, Hunters, and the Hawkery was established, rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 置奎章閣監書博士二人，秩正五品。

translations.idiomatic: 2 Kui Zhang Pavilion supervising book erudites were appointed, rank 5a.

translations.idiomatic: Tujian, Boqu, and others attacked Jinning Prefecture; Tujian declared himself King of Yunnan, Boqu became chancellor, Ahe, Hulahu, and others became associate administrators and other offices; they built ramparts and burned storehouses to resist the command.

translations.idiomatic: " It was approved.

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Yunnan Pu man came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Yunnan Pu man came to court.

sentences.zh: 賑常德、澧州路饑。

translations.literal: Changde and Lizhou routes suffered famine and were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Changde and Lizhou routes suffered famine and were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，帝及皇后、燕王阿剌忒納答剌並受佛戒。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the Emperor, the empress, and Prince of Yan Alaqa Nadala all received Buddhist precepts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor, the empress, and Prince of Yan Alaqa Nadala all received Buddhist precepts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命明宗皇子受佛戒。

translations.literal: On jihai day, it was ordered that Mingzong's sons receive Buddhist precepts.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, it was ordered that Mingzong's sons receive Buddhist precepts.

sentences.zh: 監察御史言：「中書平章朵兒只，職任臺衡，不思報效，銓選之際，紊亂綱紀，貪汙著聞，恬不知恥，黜罷為宜。

translations.literal: A surveillance censor said: "Central secretariat associate administrator Duorzhi holds the office of the scales of the heavens, yet does not think to repay his duty; at the time of selection he disorders the regulations, his greed and corruption are well known, and he is shameless — dismissal is appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.idiomatic: " It was approved.

translations.idiomatic: Yao bandits entered Guanyang County and plundered the people's property.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以兵興所收諸王也先帖木兒、搠思監等印還給之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, seals collected from princes Yesian Temür, Suosijian, and others because of military operations were returned to them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, seals collected from princes Yesian Temür, Suosijian, and others because of military operations were returned to them.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，月璐不花辭御史大夫職，不允。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Yuelu Buhua resigned the post of censor-in-chief; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Yuelu Buhua resigned the post of censor-in-chief; the request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 土蕃等處民饑，命有司以糧賑之。

translations.literal: The people of Tibetan territories suffered famine; the relevant offices were ordered to grant grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Tibetan territories suffered famine; the relevant offices were ordered to grant grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 新安、保定諸驛孳畜疫死，命中書給鈔濟其乏。

translations.literal: Xin'an, Baoding, and other relay stations' breeding livestock died of plague; the central secretariat was ordered to grant notes to relieve their want.
translations.idiomatic: Xin'an, Baoding, and other relay stations' breeding livestock died of plague; the central secretariat was ordered to grant notes to relieve their want.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，汴梁路封丘、祥符縣霜災。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Bianliang Route's Fengqiu and Xiangfu counties suffered frost disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Bianliang Route's Fengqiu and Xiangfu counties suffered frost disaster.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，流王禪之子於吉陽軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the exiled Prince Shan's son was banished to Jiyang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the exiled Prince Shan's son was banished to Jiyang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，封明宗皇子亦璘真班為鄜王。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Mingzong's son Yisinjinban was enfeoffed Prince of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Mingzong's son Yisinjinban was enfeoffed Prince of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 豫王阿剌忒納失裏所部千六百餘人饑，賑糧二月。

translations.literal: More than one thousand six hundred persons under Prince of Yu Alaqa Nadali suffered famine; two months' grain was granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: More than 1,600 persons under Prince of Yu Alaqa Nadali suffered famine; 2 months' grain were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 淮安路民饑，以兩淮鹽課鈔五萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: Huai'an Route people suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of Liang-Huai salt-tax notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'an Route people suffered famine; 50,000 ingots of Liang-Huai salt-tax notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復以阿兒思蘭海牙為江南行臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Arslan Qaya was again made Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Arslan Qaya was again made Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 命中尚卿小雲失以兵討雲南。

translations.literal: Central Court director Xiaoyunshi was ordered to take troops to suppress Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Central Court director Xiaoyunshi was ordered to take troops to suppress Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「欽察臺天歷初在上都，常與闊闊出等謀執倒剌沙，事泄，同謀者皆死，欽察臺以出征獲免。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "At the beginning of Tianli the Qipchaq Office was at Shangdu and often plotted with Kuokuochu and others to seize Toghancha'er; when the affair leaked out, the co-conspirators all died, but the Qipchaq Office was spared because of campaigning.

sentences.zh: 頃臺臣疑而劾之，不稱事情，宜雪其枉。

translations.literal: Recently censorate members suspected and impeached them, but this did not fit the facts; their wrongful treatment should be cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Recently censorate members suspected and impeached them, but this did not fit the facts; their wrongful treatment should be cleared.

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「可。

translations.idiomatic: " An imperial writ said: "Permitted.

translations.literal: " On dingwei day, Bayan was made privy council administrator, retaining his former posts as grand preceptor and recorder of weighty military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Bayan was made privy council administrator, retaining his former posts as grand preceptor and recorder of weighty military and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔諭中書曰：「昔在世祖，嘗以宰相一人總領庶務，故治出於一，政有所統。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the central secretariat: "In former times under Shizu, a single chancellor was often made to take overall charge of all affairs, so that governance issued from one source and administration had a single head.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed the central secretariat: "In former times under Shizu, a single chancellor was often made to take overall charge of all affairs, so that governance issued from one source and administration had a single head.

sentences.zh: 今燕鐵木兒為右丞相，愛顏既知樞密院事，左丞相其勿復置。

translations.literal: Now Yan Temür is right chancellor and Bayan already holds the privy council; the left chancellorship should not be reappointed.
translations.idiomatic: Now Yan Temür is right chancellor and Bayan already holds the privy council; the left chancellorship should not be reappointed.

sentences.zh: 」太禧宗禋院所隸總管府，各置副達魯花赤一人。

translations.literal: " Each directorate-general subordinate to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings was given one deputy darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: Each directorate-general subordinate to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings was given 1 deputy darughachi.

sentences.zh: 賜豫王王傅官金虎符。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yu's prince tutor was granted a gold tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yu's prince tutor was granted a gold tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命中書省及翰林國史院官祭太祖、太宗、睿宗三朝御容。

translations.literal: On wushen day, central secretariat and Hanlin National History Academy officials were ordered to sacrifice to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, central secretariat and Hanlin National History Academy officials were ordered to sacrifice to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.

sentences.zh: 以太禧宗禋使阿不海牙為中書平章政事，命史惟良及參知政事和尚總督建言之事。

translations.literal: Grand Council for Imperial Blessings commissioner Abu Haiya was made central secretariat associate administrator; Shi Weiliang and associate administrator Heshang were ordered to take overall charge of matters raised in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Council for Imperial Blessings commissioner Abu Haiya was made central secretariat associate administrator; Shi Weiliang and associate administrator Heshang were ordered to take overall charge of matters raised in memorials.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「舊制，正旦、天壽節，內外諸司各有贄獻，頃者罷之。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "By old regulation, on New Year's Day and the Heavenly Longevity Festival, inner and outer offices each had congratulatory gifts; recently this was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "By old regulation, on New Year's Day and the Heavenly Longevity Festival, inner and outer offices each had congratulatory gifts; recently this was abolished.

translations.literal: Now Jiang-Zhe provincial officials say that the sagely grace is broadly impartial and shelter extends without bound, yet we have nothing with which to repay it; whenever we encounter celebratory rites, we present memorials offering congratulations — we request that the old regulation be restored as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Now Jiang-Zhe provincial officials say that the sagely grace is broadly impartial and shelter extends without bound, yet we have nothing with which to repay it; whenever we encounter celebratory rites, we present memorials offering congratulations — we request that the old regulation be restored as appropriate.

translations.idiomatic: An imperial-seal edict was issued reaffirming the prohibition on the salt monopoly law.

translations.literal: The rent and tax submitted by forty thousand households of the people of Chongde County, Jiaxing Route, was used to supply the annual grants of money and silks to Yingzong's consorts.
translations.idiomatic: The rent and tax submitted by 40,000 households of the people of Chongde County, Jiaxing Route, was used to supply the annual grants of money and silks to Yingzong's consorts.

translations.literal: An edict instructed the Privy Council: use ten thousand ingots of notes from garrison-field grain to assist in building a Buddhist temple, and exempt its soldiers from corvée labor on construction and earthworks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed the Privy Council: use 10,000 ingots of notes from garrison-field grain to assist in building a Buddhist temple, and exempt its soldiers from corvée labor on construction and earthworks.

translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Mongol relay households of the Remote West were famished; fodder and grain were granted in graded amounts.

translations.literal: Five thousand ingots of notes were dispensed to relieve Henan migrants returning home.
translations.idiomatic: 5,000 ingots of notes were dispensed to relieve Henan migrants returning home.

translations.literal: Three thousand famine households in Tai'an Prefecture, seven thousand seven hundred in Nangong County of Zhending, eighteen thousand two hundred in Songjiang Prefecture, and famine within the Tibetan Dolijis Altimish wanhu command — the local offices in each place were ordered to relieve according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: 3,000 famine households in Tai'an Prefecture, 7,700 in Nangong County of Zhending, 18,200 in Songjiang Prefecture, and famine within the Tibetan Dolijis Altimish wanhu command — the local offices in each place were ordered to relieve according to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 濟寧路饑民四萬四千九百戶，賑以山東鹽課鈔萬錠。

translations.literal: Forty-four thousand nine hundred famine households in Jining Route were relieved with ten thousand ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy.
translations.idiomatic: 44,900 famine households in Jining Route were relieved with 10,000 ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy.

sentences.zh: 杭州火，賑糧一月。

translations.literal: Hangzhou suffered fire; one month of relief grain was dispensed.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou suffered fire; 1 month of relief grain was dispensed.

sentences.zh: 命市故瀛國公趙鳷田，為大龍翔集慶寺永業。

translations.literal: Orders were issued to purchase fields of the former Duke of Ying Zhao Xian to serve as perpetual endowment for the Great Longxiang Jiqing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Orders were issued to purchase fields of the former Duke of Ying Zhao Xian to serve as perpetual endowment for the Great Longxiang Jiqing Temple.

translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said there was no need to give payment; the Emperor said: "I build the temple for the sake of posterity and the common people; if I take men's fields without giving payment, that is not my intent.

sentences.zh: 」察罕腦兒宣慰司所部千戶察剌等衛饑者萬四千四百五十六人，人給鈔一錠。

translations.literal: Fourteen thousand four hundred fifty-six famished persons among the guard units of qianhu Chala and others under the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission — each was given one ingot of notes.
translations.idiomatic: 14,456 famished persons among the guard units of qianhu Chala and others under the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission — each was given 1 ingot of notes.

translations.literal: Third month, on jiayin day, the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to supply the spirit-shrine hall sacrifices for Empress Xianyi Zhuangsheng.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on jiayin day, the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to supply the spirit-shrine hall sacrifices for Empress Xianyi Zhuangsheng.

translations.idiomatic: 3,000 Guai Xi barbarians entered Songli Mountain and burned border garrison camps and forts.

translations.idiomatic: Xucheng County of Dongping Route was famished; relief was given with notes from the Shandong salt levy.

translations.idiomatic: The 5 routes Anqing, Anfeng, Qi, Huang, and Lu were famished; relief was given with notes from the Huai-Xi surveillance commission's fines and confiscations.

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Prince of Jiyang Munai was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Wu; Prince of Wu Popi was made Prince of Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Prince of Jiyang Munai was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Wu; Prince of Wu Popi was made Prince of Jiyang.

translations.literal: Each of the native officials of the Eight Tribes Shunyuan, Qujing, Wusa, Wumeng, Mengqing, Luolosi, and Songming Prefecture was granted one bolt of silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the native officials of the Eight Tribes Shunyuan, Qujing, Wusa, Wumeng, Mengqing, Luolosi, and Songming Prefecture was granted 1 bolt of silks and cloth.

sentences.zh: 禁泛濫給驛。

translations.literal: Indiscriminate grants at relays were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Indiscriminate grants at relays were prohibited.

sentences.zh: 四川官吏脅從囊加臺者皆復故職。

translations.literal: Sichuan officials who had been coerced into following Nangjiatai were all restored to their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan officials who had been coerced into following Nangjiatai were all restored to their former posts.

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the prince Alaqtenashiri was enfeoffed Prince of Yan; a palace chancellor's office was established to oversee his household affairs, rank 2a, with Yan Temür in charge.

translations.idiomatic: The palace examination for jinshi was held; 97 persons including Dolatu and Wang Wenye were granted ranked pass and origin status in varying grades.

translations.literal: Zhangde Route was ordered to perform annual sacrifices at the Zhou King Wen shrine in Youli.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde Route was ordered to perform annual sacrifices at the Zhou King Wen shrine in Youli.

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu was made Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor; Eight Tribes Shunyuan pacification commissioner Timur Buqa was made Yunnan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor — to campaign against Yunnan with the Prince of Yu by the Eight Tribes route.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu was made Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor; Eight Tribes Shunyuan pacification commissioner Timur Buqa was made Yunnan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor — to campaign against Yunnan with the Prince of Yu by the Eight Tribes route.

translations.literal: Mingzong's seventy close attendants were granted offices in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong's 70 close attendants were granted offices in varying grades.

translations.idiomatic: 100,000 shi of rice was issued to sell grain in relief to the capital's poor.
