translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, princes Sangqan, Satemish, and Maju were dispatched on separate missions to the northwest to princes Yaziqitai, Ozbeg, Közbeg, and others.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔諭中外，命御史大夫鐵木兒補化、月璐不花振舉臺綱。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, an edict announced to the empire: censor-in-chief Timur Buqa and Yuelu Buhua were ordered to revive censorate authority.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, an edict announced to the empire: censor-in-chief Timur Buqa and Yuelu Buhua were ordered to revive censorate authority.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，木八剌沙來貢蒲萄酒，賜鈔幣有差。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Mubaraqsha came to offer tribute wine; notes and silks were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Mubaraqsha came to offer tribute wine; notes and silks were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 以山東鹽課鈔萬錠賑東昌饑民三萬三千六百戶。

translations.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy were used to relieve thirty-three thousand six hundred famine households in Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy were used to relieve 33,600 famine households in Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，議明宗升祔，序於英宗之上，視順宗、成宗廟遷之例。

translations.literal: On jisi day, deliberation on elevating Mingzong to join the ancestral temple — ordering him above Yingzong, taking as precedent the cases of relocating Shunzong's and Chengzong's temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, deliberation on elevating Mingzong to join the ancestral temple — ordering him above Yingzong, taking as precedent the cases of relocating Shunzong's and Chengzong's temples.

sentences.zh: 辛未，群臣請上皇帝尊號，不許，固請不已，乃許之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the hundred officials requested an honorific title for the Emperor; not granted; they pressed repeatedly without cease — then it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the hundred officials requested an honorific title for the Emperor; not granted; they pressed repeatedly without cease — then it was granted.

sentences.zh: 封知樞密院事不花帖木兒為武平郡王。

translations.literal: Privy council administrator Buhua Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Wuping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Buhua Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Wuping commandery.

sentences.zh: 錄討雲南禿堅、伯忽之功，雲南宣慰使土官舉宗、祿余並遙授雲南行省參知政事，余賜賚有差。

translations.literal: The achievements of suppressing Yunnan's Tujan and Buqa were recorded; Yunnan pacification commissioner native officials Juzong and Lü Yu were both remotely appointed Yunnan Branch Secretariat associate administrators; Lü Yu's gifts were in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The achievements of suppressing Yunnan's Tujan and Buqa were recorded; Yunnan pacification commissioner native officials Juzong and Lü Yu were both remotely appointed Yunnan Branch Secretariat associate administrators; Lü Yu's gifts were in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 分龍慶州隸大都路。

translations.literal: Longqing Prefecture was detached and made subordinate to Dadu Route.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing Prefecture was detached and made subordinate to Dadu Route.

sentences.zh: 諸王也孫臺部七百餘人入天山縣，掠民財產，遣樞密院、宗正府官往捕之。

translations.literal: More than seven hundred of Prince Yesutai's following entered Tianshan County and plundered people's property; Privy Council and Imperial Clan Court officials were dispatched to arrest them.
translations.idiomatic: More than 700 of Prince Yesutai's following entered Tianshan County and plundered people's property; Privy Council and Imperial Clan Court officials were dispatched to arrest them.

sentences.zh: 壬申，奉玉冊、玉寶，祔明宗神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On renshen day, jade registers and jade seal were presented; Mingzong's spirit tablet was joined in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, jade registers and jade seal were presented; Mingzong's spirit tablet was joined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 濮州臨清、館陶二縣饑，賑鈔七千錠。

translations.literal: Puzhou's Linqing and Guantao two counties were famished; seven thousand ingots of notes for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Puzhou's Linqing and Guantao 2 counties were famished; 7,000 ingots of notes for relief.

sentences.zh: 光州光山縣饑，出官粟萬石，下其直賑糶。

translations.literal: Guangshan County of Guang Prefecture was famished; ten thousand shi of government grain was released at reduced price for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshan County of Guang Prefecture was famished; 10,000 shi of government grain was released at reduced price for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 信陽、息州及光之固始縣饑，並以附近倉糧賑之。

translations.literal: Xinyang, Xi Prefecture, and Gushi County of Guang were famished; nearby granary grain was used to relieve them all.
translations.idiomatic: Xinyang, Xi Prefecture, and Gushi County of Guang were famished; nearby granary grain was used to relieve them all.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，封諸王速來蠻為西寧王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Prince Sulaiman was enfeoffed Prince of Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Prince Sulaiman was enfeoffed Prince of Xining.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，西番哈剌火州來貢蒲萄酒。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Western Tibet's Karakhoja came to offer tribute wine.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Western Tibet's Karakhoja came to offer tribute wine.

sentences.zh: 諸王、駙馬還鎮，錫賚有差。

translations.literal: Princes and consort kings returned to their garrisons; gifts were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and consort kings returned to their garrisons; gifts were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙子，改山東都萬戶府為都督府。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the Shandong commander-in-chief's office was changed to a commander-in-chief prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Shandong commander-in-chief's office was changed to a commander-in-chief prefecture.

sentences.zh: 雲南木邦路土官渾都來貢方物。

translations.literal: Yunnan's Mubang Route native official Hundu came to offer tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's Mubang Route native official Hundu came to offer tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 河南登封、偃師、孟津諸縣饑，賑以兩淮鹽課鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Dengfeng, Yanshi, Mengjin and other counties of Henan were famished; thirty thousand ingots from the Two Huai salt levy were used for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Dengfeng, Yanshi, Mengjin and other counties of Henan were famished; 30,000 ingots from the Two Huai salt levy were used for relief.

sentences.zh: 鞏昌、臨洮、蘭州、定西州饑，賑鈔三千五百錠。

translations.literal: Gongchang, Lintao, Lanzhou, and Dingxi Prefecture were famished; three thousand five hundred ingots for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchang, Lintao, Lanzhou, and Dingxi Prefecture were famished; 3,500 ingots for relief.

sentences.zh: 沂、莒、膠、密、寧海五州饑，賑糧五千石。

translations.literal: Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai five prefectures were famished; five thousand shi of relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai 5 prefectures were famished; 5,000 shi of relief grain.

sentences.zh: 中興、峽州、歸州、安陸、沔陽饑戶三十萬有奇，賑糧四月。

translations.literal: Zhongxing, Xia, Guizhou, Anlu, and Mianyang — famine households exceeding three hundred thousand — four months of relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxing, Xia, Guizhou, Anlu, and Mianyang — famine households exceeding 300,000 — 4 months of relief grain.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，升太常禮儀院秩正二品。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ceremonies was promoted to rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ceremonies was promoted to rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 敕有司供明宗後八不沙宮分幣帛二百匹，及阿梯裏、脫忽思幣帛有差。

translations.literal: An edict ordered relevant offices to supply two hundred bolts of silks and cloth for the household allotment of Mingzong's consort Babusha, and silks and cloth for Atli and Toghos in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered relevant offices to supply 200 bolts of silks and cloth for the household allotment of Mingzong's consort Babusha, and silks and cloth for Atli and Toghos in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 賜燕鐵木兒功勛之碑。

translations.literal: A stele recording Yan Temür's meritorious achievements was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A stele recording Yan Temür's meritorious achievements was granted.

sentences.zh: 廣平路饑，以河間鹽課鈔萬三千錠賑之。

translations.literal: Guangping Route was famished; thirteen thousand ingots from the Hejian salt levy were used for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Guangping Route was famished; 13,000 ingots from the Hejian salt levy were used for relief.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，諸王哈兒蠻遣使來貢蒲萄酒。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Prince Qariman dispatched envoys to offer tribute wine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Prince Qariman dispatched envoys to offer tribute wine.

sentences.zh: 廣德、太平、集慶等路饑，凡數百萬戶。

translations.literal: Guangde, Taiping, Jiqing and other routes were famished — altogether several million households.
translations.idiomatic: Guangde, Taiping, Jiqing and other routes were famished — altogether several million households.

sentences.zh: 濮州諸縣蟲食桑葉將盡。

translations.literal: In Puzhou's various counties worms were eating mulberry leaves nearly to exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: In Puzhou's various counties worms were eating mulberry leaves nearly to exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午朔，命西僧作佛事於仁智殿，自是日始，至十二月終罷。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renwu new moon — Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites in the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom; from this day it began, until the twelfth month when it ended.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, renwu new moon — Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites in the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom; from this day it began, until the 12th month when it ended.

sentences.zh: 癸未，置怯憐口錢糧都總管府，秩正三品。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the Directorate General for provision lands and grain for qalan households was established, rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Directorate General for provision lands and grain for qalan households was established, rank 3a.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「各宮分及宿衛士歲賜錢帛，舊額萬人，去歲增四千人，邇者增數益廣，請依舊額為宜。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Annual grants of money and silks to each palace allotment and bodyguard soldiers — the old quota was ten thousand men; last year it increased by four thousand; recently the increase has grown broader — we request it be appropriate to follow the old quota.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Annual grants of money and silks to each palace allotment and bodyguard soldiers — the old quota was 10,000 men; last year it increased by 4,000; recently the increase has grown broader — we request it be appropriate to follow the old quota.

sentences.zh: 」詔命阿不海牙裁省以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Abuhaiya to deliberate reductions and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Abuhaiya to deliberate reductions and report.

sentences.zh: 甲申，時享太廟。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, seasonal offering at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, seasonal offering at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，封也真也不幹為桓國公。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Yejin Buyan was enfeoffed Duke of the State of Huan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Yejin Buyan was enfeoffed Duke of the State of Huan.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒言：「天歷初，阿速軍士為國有勞，請以鈔十萬錠、米十萬石分給其家。

translations.literal: Yan Temür said: "At the start of Tianli, Ashiq soldiers toiled meritoriously for the state — I request one hundred thousand ingots of notes and one hundred thousand shi of rice be divided and given to their families.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür said: "At the start of Tianli, Ashiq soldiers toiled meritoriously for the state — I request 100,000 ingots of notes and 100,000 shi of rice be divided and given to their families.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 戊子，四川行省調重慶五路萬戶以兵救雲南。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Sichuan Branch Secretariat mobilized Chongqing's five-route ten-thousand households to send troops to rescue Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Sichuan Branch Secretariat mobilized Chongqing's five-route ten-thousand households to send troops to rescue Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，中書省臣言：「邇者諸處民饑，累常賑救，去歲賑鈔百三十四萬九千六百餘錠、糧二十五萬一千七百餘石。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, central secretariat officials said: "Recently the people in various places have been famished; relief has repeatedly been given; last year relief was one million three hundred forty-nine thousand six hundred-odd ingots of notes and two hundred fifty-one thousand seven hundred-odd shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, central secretariat officials said: "Recently the people in various places have been famished; relief has repeatedly been given; last year relief was 1,349,600-odd ingots of notes and 251,700-odd shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 今汴梁、懷慶、彰德、大名、興和、衛輝、順德、歸德及高唐、泰安、徐、邳、曹、冠等州饑民六十七萬六千戶，一百一萬二千餘口，請以鈔九萬錠、米萬五千石，命有司分賑。

translations.literal: Now Bianliang, Huaiqing, Zhangde, Daming, Xinghe, Weihui, Shunde, Guide and Gaotang, Tai'an, Xu, Pi, Cao, Guan and other prefectures have six hundred seventy-six thousand famine households, one million one hundred twenty thousand-odd mouths — we request ninety thousand ingots and fifteen thousand shi of rice; order the offices to divide relief.
translations.idiomatic: Now Bianliang, Huaiqing, Zhangde, Daming, Xinghe, Weihui, Shunde, Guide and Gaotang, Tai'an, Xu, Pi, Cao, Guan and other prefectures have 676,000 famine households, 1,120,000-odd mouths — we request 90,000 ingots and 15,000 shi of rice; order the offices to divide relief.

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「可。

translations.literal: " The rescript said: "Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The rescript said: "Approved.

sentences.zh: 」以陜西饑，敕有司作佛事七日。

translations.literal: Because Shaanxi was famished, relevant offices were edicted to perform Buddhist rites for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shaanxi was famished, relevant offices were edicted to perform Buddhist rites for 7 days.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以所籍張珪諸子田四百頃，賜大承天護聖寺為永業。

translations.literal: On renchen day, four hundred qing of fields belonging to Zhang Gui's sons that had been registered was granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, 400 qing of fields belonging to Zhang Gui's sons that had been registered was granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.

sentences.zh: 沿邊部落蒙古饑民八千二百，人給鈔三錠、布二匹、糧二月，遣還其所部。

translations.literal: Eight thousand two hundred Mongol famine refugees among border tribes — each was given three ingots, two bolts of cloth, two months of grain, and sent back to their commands.
translations.idiomatic: 8,200 Mongol famine refugees among border tribes — each was given 3 ingots, 2 bolts of cloth, 2 months of grain, and sent back to their commands.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，置豫王王傅、副尉、司馬各二員。

translations.literal: On guisi day, for the Prince of Yu, two each of tutor, deputy commandant, and marshal were established.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, for the Prince of Yu, 2 each of tutor, deputy commandant, and marshal were established.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣諸王桑兀孫還雲南。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Prince Sang'ursun was dispatched back to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Prince Sang'ursun was dispatched back to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 金蘭等驛馬牛死，賑鈔五百錠。

translations.literal: At Jinlan and other relays horses and oxen died; five hundred ingots of notes for relief.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinlan and other relays horses and oxen died; 500 ingots of notes for relief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，降璽書申諭太禧宗禋院。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an imperial-seal edict was sent to reaffirm instructions to the Court of Imperial Rites of Grand Felicity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, an imperial-seal edict was sent to reaffirm instructions to the Court of Imperial Rites of Grand Felicity.

sentences.zh: 天臨之醴陵、湘陰等州、臺州之臨海等縣饑，各賑糴米五千石。

translations.literal: Liling and Xiangyin of Tianlin Route, Linhai and other counties of Taizhou — each was famished; five thousand shi of relief-sale rice each.
translations.idiomatic: Liling and Xiangyin of Tianlin Route, Linhai and other counties of Taizhou — each was famished; 5,000 shi of relief-sale rice each.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，明宗後八不沙崩。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Mingzong's consort Babusha died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Mingzong's consort Babusha died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，括益都、般陽、寧海閑田十六萬二千九十頃，賜大承天護聖寺為永業。

translations.literal: On renyin day, one hundred sixty-two thousand ninety qing of idle fields in Yidu, Panyang, and Ninghai were surveyed and granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, 162,090 qing of idle fields in Yidu, Panyang, and Ninghai were surveyed and granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.

sentences.zh: 立益都廣農提舉司及益都、般陽、寧海諸提領所，並隸隆祥總管府。

translations.literal: The Yidu Broad Agriculture Intendant Office and intendant agencies in Yidu, Panyang, and Ninghai were established — all subordinate to the Longxiang Directorate General.
translations.idiomatic: The Yidu Broad Agriculture Intendant Office and intendant agencies in Yidu, Panyang, and Ninghai were established — all subordinate to the Longxiang Directorate General.

sentences.zh: 烏撒土官祿余殺烏撒宣慰司官吏，降於伯忽。

translations.literal: Wusa native official Lü Yu killed Wusa pacification commission officials and surrendered to Buqa.
translations.idiomatic: Wusa native official Lü Yu killed Wusa pacification commission officials and surrendered to Buqa.

sentences.zh: 羅羅諸蠻俱叛，與伯忽相應，平章帖木兒不花為其所害。

translations.literal: All the Luoluo barbarians rebelled in concert with Buqa; grand councillor Timur Buqa was killed by them.
translations.idiomatic: All the Luoluo barbarians rebelled in concert with Buqa; grand councillor Timur Buqa was killed by them.

sentences.zh: 晉寧、建昌二路民饑，賑糧五萬五千石、鈔二萬三千錠。

translations.literal: Jinning and Jianchang two routes' people were famished — fifty-five thousand shi of relief grain and twenty-three thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Jinning and Jianchang 2 routes' people were famished — 55,000 shi of relief grain and 23,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 戊申，陜西行臺言：「奉元、鞏昌、鳳翔等路以累歲饑，不能具五穀種，請給鈔二萬錠，俾分糴於他郡。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Shaanxi Branch Censorate said: "Fengyuan, Gongchang, Fengxiang and other routes, because of successive years of famine, cannot obtain five-grain seed — we request twenty thousand ingots so they may divide purchases of grain in other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Shaanxi Branch Censorate said: "Fengyuan, Gongchang, Fengxiang and other routes, because of successive years of famine, cannot obtain five-grain seed — we request 20,000 ingots so they may divide purchases of grain in other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 雲南賊祿余以蠻兵七百餘人拒烏撒、順元界，立關固守。

translations.literal: Yunnan bandit Lü Yu with more than seven hundred barbarian troops blocked the Wusa-Shunyuan border, established passes and held firm.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan bandit Lü Yu with more than 700 barbarian troops blocked the Wusa-Shunyuan border, established passes and held firm.

sentences.zh: 重慶五路萬戶軍至雲南境，值羅羅蠻，萬餘人遇害，千戶祝天祥等引余眾遁還。

translations.literal: Chongqing five-route wanhu troops reached Yunnan's borders, encountered Luoluo barbarians — more than ten thousand men were killed; qianhu Zhu Tianxiang and others led the remainder in flight back.
translations.idiomatic: Chongqing five-route wanhu troops reached Yunnan's borders, encountered Luoluo barbarians — more than 10,000 men were killed; qianhu Zhu Tianxiang and others led the remainder in flight back.

sentences.zh: 詔江浙、河南、江西三省調兵二萬，命諸王雲都思帖木兒及樞密判官洪浹將之，與湖廣行省平章脫歡會兵討雲南。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jiang-Zhe, Henan, and Jiangxi three branch secretariats to mobilize twenty thousand troops; Prince Yundushi Temür and privy council judge Hong Jia were ordered to lead them — to join Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tughuan's army in suppressing Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jiang-Zhe, Henan, and Jiangxi 3 branch secretariats to mobilize 20,000 troops; Prince Yundushi Temür and privy council judge Hong Jia were ordered to lead them — to join Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tughuan's army in suppressing Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，作佛事。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Buddhist rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Buddhist rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 是月，滄州、高唐州屬縣蟲食桑葉盡。

translations.literal: This month, in counties subordinate to Cangzhou and Gaotang Prefecture worms ate mulberry leaves entirely.
translations.idiomatic: This month, in counties subordinate to Cangzhou and Gaotang Prefecture worms ate mulberry leaves entirely.

sentences.zh: 芍陂屯饑，賑糧二月。

translations.literal: Shaobo colony was famished; two months of relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: Shaobo colony was famished; 2 months of relief grain.

sentences.zh: 土蕃等處脫思麻民饑，命有司賑之。

translations.literal: Tibetan areas' Tesima people were famished; relevant offices were ordered to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan areas' Tesima people were famished; relevant offices were ordered to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 賑懷慶承恩、孟州等驛鈔千錠。

translations.literal: One thousand ingots of notes to relieve Chen'en of Huaiqing, Meng Prefecture and other relays.
translations.idiomatic: 1,000 ingots of notes to relieve Chen'en of Huaiqing, Meng Prefecture and other relays.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，遣宣徽使定住等，以受尊號告祭南郊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yimao day, Xuanhui commissioner Dingzhu and others were dispatched to announce and perform southern suburban sacrifices for receiving the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on yimao day, Xuanhui commissioner Dingzhu and others were dispatched to announce and perform southern suburban sacrifices for receiving the honorific title.

sentences.zh: 故四川行省平章寬徹、四川道廉訪使忽都魯養阿等，皆為囊加臺所害，並贈官賜謚。

translations.literal: Former Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Kuanche, Sichuan Circuit surveillance commissioner Huduruyanga, and others — all were killed by Nangjiatai — posthumous offices and posthumous titles were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Former Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Kuanche, Sichuan Circuit surveillance commissioner Huduruyanga, and others — all were killed by Nangjiatai — posthumous offices and posthumous titles were granted.

sentences.zh: 榆次縣主簿太帖木兒、河中府判官禿塔兒，皆為遼東軍所害，並加褒贈。

translations.literal: Yuci County clerk Tai Temür and Hezhong Prefecture judge Tutuar — both were killed by Liaodong troops — enhanced posthumous honors were added.
translations.idiomatic: Yuci County clerk Tai Temür and Hezhong Prefecture judge Tutuar — both were killed by Liaodong troops — enhanced posthumous honors were added.

sentences.zh: 戊午，帝御大明殿，燕帖木兒率文武百官及僧道、耆老，奉玉冊、玉寶，上尊號曰欽天統聖至德誠功大文孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the Emperor presided in the Great Brightness Hall; Yan Temür led civil and military officials, monks and Taoists, and elders — presenting jade registers and jade seal — to offer the honorific title Reverent Heaven, Unifying Sagacity, Perfect Virtue, Sincere Achievement, Great Culture, Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor presided in the Great Brightness Hall; Yan Temür led civil and military officials, monks and Taoists, and elders — presenting jade registers and jade seal — to offer the honorific title Reverent Heaven, Unifying Sagacity, Perfect Virtue, Sincere Achievement, Great Culture, Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是日，改元至順，詔天下。

translations.literal: That day, the era name was changed to Zhishun; announced to the empire.
translations.idiomatic: That day, the era name was changed to Zhishun; announced to the empire.

sentences.zh: 河南、懷慶、衛輝、晉寧四路曾經賑濟人戶，今歲差發全行蠲免，其餘被災路份人民已經賑濟者，腹裏差發、江淮夏稅，亦免三分。

translations.literal: Henan, Huaiqing, Weihui, and Jinning four routes — households that had already received relief — this year's levies were entirely remitted; for the rest among disaster-affected routes' people who had received relief — interior levies and Jiang-Huai summer tax were also remitted three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, Huaiqing, Weihui, and Jinning 4 routes — households that had already received relief — this year's levies were entirely remitted; for the rest among disaster-affected routes' people who had received relief — interior levies and Jiang-Huai summer tax were also remitted three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 己未，羅羅斯權土官宣慰撒加伯、阿漏土官阿剌、裏州土官德益叛，附於祿余。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Luolosi acting native official pacification commissioner Sajabo, Alou native official Ala, Lai Prefecture native official Deyi rebelled and adhered to Lü Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Luolosi acting native official pacification commissioner Sajabo, Alou native official Ala, Lai Prefecture native official Deyi rebelled and adhered to Lü Yu.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以受尊號恭謝太廟。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, because of receiving the honorific title, reverent thanksgiving was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, because of receiving the honorific title, reverent thanksgiving was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，四川行省討雲南，進軍至烏蒙。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Sichuan Branch Secretariat forces campaigning against Yunnan advanced to Wumeng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Sichuan Branch Secretariat forces campaigning against Yunnan advanced to Wumeng.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，歸德府之譙縣霧傷麥。

translations.literal: On renxu day in Qiao County of Guide Prefecture fog damaged the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in Qiao County of Guide Prefecture fog damaged the wheat.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，四川軍至雲南之雪山峽，遇羅羅斯軍，敗之。

translations.literal: On guihai day Sichuan troops reached Snow Mountain Gorge in Yunnan, encountered Luoluo forces, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Sichuan troops reached Snow Mountain Gorge in Yunnan, encountered Luoluo forces, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 德州饑，賑以山東鹽課鈔三千錠。

translations.literal: Dezhou had famine; they were relieved with three thousand ingots of Shandong salt duty notes.
translations.idiomatic: Dezhou had famine; they were relieved with 3,000 ingots of Shandong salt duty notes.

sentences.zh: 武昌路饑，賑以糧五萬石、鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: Wuchang Route had famine; they were relieved with fifty thousand shi of grain and two thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchang Route had famine; they were relieved with 50,000 shi of grain and 2,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 甲子，申命燕鐵木兒為中書右丞相，詔天下。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Yan Temür was again appointed central secretariat right chancellor, with an edict proclaimed to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Yan Temür was again appointed central secretariat right chancellor, with an edict proclaimed to the realm.

sentences.zh: 以鈔四萬錠分給宮人，賜魯國大長公主鈔萬錠。

translations.literal: Forty thousand ingots of notes were distributed to palace women; the Grand Princess of Lu was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: 40,000 ingots of notes were distributed to palace women; the Grand Princess of Lu was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，翰林國史院修《英宗實錄》成。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy completed compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy completed compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Yingzong.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，車駕發大都，次大口。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the imperial procession set out from Dadu and halted at Dagu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the imperial procession set out from Dadu and halted at Dagu.

sentences.zh: 升尚舍寺秩正三品。

translations.literal: Shangshe Temple was promoted to rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: Shangshe Temple was promoted to rank 3a.

sentences.zh: 命阿鄰帖木兒為大司徒。

translations.literal: Alinj Temür was appointed grand minister of husbandry.
translations.idiomatic: Alinj Temür was appointed grand minister of husbandry.

sentences.zh: 遣豫王阿剌忒納失裏鎮西番，授以金印。

translations.literal: Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri was dispatched to guard the western Tibetans and was granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri was dispatched to guard the western Tibetans and was granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王脫歡金印，大司徒不蘭奚銀印。

translations.literal: Prince Tuohuan was granted a gold seal; grand minister of husbandry Buralanxi was granted a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tuohuan was granted a gold seal; grand minister of husbandry Buralanxi was granted a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 加趙世延翰林學士承旨，封魯國公。

translations.literal: Zhao Shiyan was advanced to Hanlin academician expositor and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shiyan was advanced to Hanlin academician expositor and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.

sentences.zh: 賑衛輝、大名、廬州饑民鈔六千錠、糧五千石。

translations.literal: Famine households in Weihui, Daming, and Luzhou were relieved with six thousand ingots of notes and five thousand shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Famine households in Weihui, Daming, and Luzhou were relieved with 6,000 ingots of notes and 5,000 shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 開元路胡裏該萬戶府、寧夏路哈赤千戶所軍士饑，各賑糧二月。

translations.literal: Troops of the Huligai wanhu prefecture in Kaiyuan Route and the Qachi chiliarchate in Ningxia Route who were suffering famine were each given one month's relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: Troops of the Huligai wanhu prefecture in Kaiyuan Route and the Qachi chiliarchate in Ningxia Route who were suffering famine were each given 1 month's relief grain.

sentences.zh: 己巳，次龍虎臺。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the court halted at Longhu Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the court halted at Longhu Terrace.

sentences.zh: 置肅王寬徹傅、尉、司馬各一員。

translations.literal: One tutor, commandant, and marshal each were established for Prince Suo Kunche.
translations.idiomatic: 1 tutor, commandant, and marshal each were established for Prince Suo Kunche.

sentences.zh: 辛未，置宣忠扈衛親軍都萬戶府，秩正三品，總幹羅思軍士，隸樞密院。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the Xuanzhong Imperial Guard Army Commander-in-Chief's Office was established, rank 3a, overseeing Alan troops, subordinate to the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Xuanzhong Imperial Guard Army Commander-in-Chief's Office was established, rank 3a, overseeing Alan troops, subordinate to the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 以太禧宗禋使亦列赤為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: Grand director of the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Office Yiliechi was made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Grand director of the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Office Yiliechi was made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 左、右欽察、龍翊侍衛軍士五千三百七十戶饑，戶賑鈔二錠、布一匹、糧一月。

translations.literal: Five thousand three hundred seventy households of Left and Right Qipchaq and Dragon Escort guard soldiers who were suffering famine — each household was relieved with two ingots of notes, one bolt of cloth, and one month's grain.
translations.idiomatic: 5,370 households of Left and Right Qipchaq and Dragon Escort guard soldiers who were suffering famine — each household was relieved with 2 ingots of notes, 1 bolt of cloth, and 1 month's grain.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣使勞軍於雲南。

translations.literal: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched to comfort the army in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched to comfort the army in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 時諸王禿剌率萬戶忽都魯沙、怯列、孛羅等，皆領兵進討禿堅、伯忽。

translations.literal: At the time Prince Tula leading wanhu Hudurlu Sha, Qielie, Boluo, and others all commanded troops to advance and attack Tuojian and Bohu.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Prince Tula leading wanhu Hudurlu Sha, Qielie, Boluo, and others all commanded troops to advance and attack Tuojian and Bohu.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，八番乖西<角┦>苗阿馬、察伯秩等萬人侵擾邊境，詔樞密臣分兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day ten thousand men of the Eight Fan Guaixi Miao led by Ama, Chabo Zhi, and others raided the borderlands; an order commanded privy council officials to divide troops and attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day 10,000 men of the Eight Fan Guaixi Miao led by Ama, Chabo Zhi, and others raided the borderlands; an order commanded privy council officials to divide troops and attack them.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，置順元宣撫司，統答剌罕軍征雲南，人賜鈔五錠。

translations.literal: On yihai day the Shunyuan Pacification Commission was established, overseeing Dalan Khan troops campaigning against Yunnan; each man was granted five ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Shunyuan Pacification Commission was established, overseeing Dalan Khan troops campaigning against Yunnan; each man was granted 5 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 衛輝路之輝州，以荒乏谷種，給鈔三千錠，俾糴於他郡。

translations.literal: In Huizhou of Weihui Route, because of scarcity of grain and seed, three thousand ingots of notes were given to enable purchase in other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In Huizhou of Weihui Route, because of scarcity of grain and seed, 3,000 ingots of notes were given to enable purchase in other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣使詣五臺山作佛事。

translations.literal: On jimao day envoys were dispatched to Wutai Mountain to perform Buddhist rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day envoys were dispatched to Wutai Mountain to perform Buddhist rites.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命湖廣行省以鈔五萬錠給雲南軍需。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply fifty thousand ingots of notes for Yunnan military needs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply 50,000 ingots of notes for Yunnan military needs.

sentences.zh: 是月，右衛左右手屯田大水，害禾稼八百餘頃。

translations.literal: That month the Right Guard left and right hand colony fields had great flood, ruining more than eight hundred qing of grain.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Right Guard left and right hand colony fields had great flood, ruining more than 800 qing of grain.

sentences.zh: 廣平、河南、大名、般陽、南陽、濟寧、東平、汴梁等路，高唐、開、濮、輝、德、冠、滑等州，及大有、千斯等屯田蝗。

translations.literal: Guangping, Henan, Daming, Panyang, Nanyang, Jining, Dongping, Bianliang and other routes, Gaotang, Kai, Pu, Hui, De, Guan, Hua and other prefectures, and Dayou, Qiansi and other colony fields had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Guangping, Henan, Daming, Panyang, Nanyang, Jining, Dongping, Bianliang and other routes, Gaotang, Kai, Pu, Hui, De, Guan, Hua and other prefectures, and Dayou, Qiansi and other colony fields had locusts.

sentences.zh: 以浙東宣慰使陳天祐、湖廣參知政事樊楫死於王事，贈封特加一級。

translations.literal: Because Zhedong Pacification Commissioner Chen Tianyou and Huguang associate administrator Fan Qi died in the ruler's service, enfeoffment titles were specially advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Because Zhedong Pacification Commissioner Chen Tianyou and Huguang associate administrator Fan Qi died in the ruler's service, enfeoffment titles were specially advanced one grade.

sentences.zh: 龍興張仁興妻鄒氏、奉元李郁妻崔氏以誌節，汴梁尹華以孝行，皆旌其門。

translations.literal: Zou Shi of Longxing, wife of Zhang Renxing, Cui Shi of Fengyuan, wife of Li Yu — all for recorded integrity; Hua Yin of Bianliang for filial conduct — all had their gates honored.
translations.idiomatic: Zou Shi of Longxing, wife of Zhang Renxing, Cui Shi of Fengyuan, wife of Li Yu — all for recorded integrity; Hua Yin of Bianliang for filial conduct — all had their gates honored.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳朔，燕鐵木兒言：「向有旨，惟許臣及伯顏兼領三職。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinsi new moon, Yan Temür said: "Previously there was an edict permitting only your subject and Bayan concurrently to hold three posts.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on xinsi new moon, Yan Temür said: "Previously there was an edict permitting only your subject and Bayan concurrently to hold three posts.

sentences.zh: 今趙世延以平章政事兼翰林學士承旨、奎章閣大學士，引疾以辭。

translations.literal: Now Zhao Shiyan as grand councillor concurrently holds Hanlin academician expositor and Kuizhang Pavilion academician, citing illness to resign.
translations.idiomatic: Now Zhao Shiyan as grand councillor concurrently holds Hanlin academician expositor and Kuizhang Pavilion academician, citing illness to resign.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「朕重老成人，其令世延仍視事中書，果病，無預銓選可也。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "We esteem elders; let Shiyan still attend to central secretariat affairs; if he is truly ill, he need not participate in selection and appointment."
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "We esteem elders; let Shiyan still attend to central secretariat affairs; if he is truly ill, he need not participate in selection and appointment."

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，大駕至上都。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the great procession reached Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the great procession reached Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，給左、右欽察、龍翊侍衛軍士糧。

translations.literal: On wuzi day grain was disbursed to Left and Right Qipchaq and Dragon Escort guard soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day grain was disbursed to Left and Right Qipchaq and Dragon Escort guard soldiers.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，鎮江饑，賑糧四萬石。

translations.literal: On renchen day Zhenjiang had famine; four thousand shi of grain were disbursed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Zhenjiang had famine; 4,000 shi of grain were disbursed in relief.

sentences.zh: 饒州饑，亦命有司賑之。

translations.literal: Raozhou had famine; relevant offices were also ordered to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: Raozhou had famine; relevant offices were also ordered to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，御史臺臣言：「宣徽院錢谷，出納無經，以上供飲膳，冒昧者多，不稽其案牘，則弊日滋。

translations.literal: On guisi day censorate officials said: "Xuanhui Court money and grain, receipts and disbursements without regularity — for imperial supplies and drink and food, many presumptuously claim without auditing their documents, then abuses daily grow.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day censorate officials said: "Xuanhui Court money and grain, receipts and disbursements without regularity — for imperial supplies and drink and food, many presumptuously claim without auditing their documents, then abuses daily grow.

sentences.zh: 宜如舊制，具實上之省部，以備考核。

translations.literal: It would be fitting to follow the old system — report truthfully to the branch secretariat and ministry to prepare for inspection and assessment.
translations.idiomatic: It would be fitting to follow the old system — report truthfully to the branch secretariat and ministry to prepare for inspection and assessment.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 丙申，立行樞密院討雲南，賜給驛璽書十五、銀字圓符五。

translations.literal: On bingshen day a mobile privy council was established to campaign against Yunnan; fifteen relay-seal edicts and five silver-character round tallies were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day a mobile privy council was established to campaign against Yunnan; 15 relay-seal edicts and 5 silver-character round tallies were granted.

sentences.zh: 以河南行省平章徹裏鐵木兒知行樞密院事，陜西行省平章探馬赤、近侍教化為同知、副使。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Cherig Temür was made to administer mobile privy council affairs; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tanma Chi and attendant Jiaohua were made associate administrator and vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Cherig Temür was made to administer mobile privy council affairs; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tanma Chi and attendant Jiaohua were made associate administrator and vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 發朵甘思、朵思麻及鞏昌諸處軍萬三千人，人乘馬三匹。

translations.literal: Troops of thirteen thousand from Duogan, Duosima, and Gongchang and other places were mobilized; each man was given three horses.
translations.idiomatic: Troops of 13,000 from Duogan, Duosima, and Gongchang and other places were mobilized; each man was given 3 horses.

sentences.zh: 徹裏鐵木兒同鎮西武靖王搠思班等由四川，教化從豫王阿剌忒納失裏等由八番，分道進軍。

translations.literal: Cherig Temür together with Western Pacification Prince Suosi Ban and others advanced by way of Sichuan; Jiaohua followed Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri and others by way of the Eight Fan — advancing by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Cherig Temür together with Western Pacification Prince Suosi Ban and others advanced by way of Sichuan; Jiaohua followed Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri and others by way of the Eight Fan — advancing by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 黃河溢，大名路之屬縣沒民田五百八十餘頃。

translations.literal: The Yellow River overflowed; attached counties of Daming Route had five hundred eighty-odd qing of civilian fields inundated.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River overflowed; attached counties of Daming Route had 580-odd qing of civilian fields inundated.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以內侍中瑞卿撒裏為大司徒，賜四川行省左丞孛羅金虎符。

translations.literal: On gengzi day inner attendant Zhong Ruiqing Sali was appointed grand minister of husbandry; Sichuan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Boluo was granted a gold tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day inner attendant Zhong Ruiqing Sali was appointed grand minister of husbandry; Sichuan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Boluo was granted a gold tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 以鹽課鈔二十萬錠供雲南軍需。

translations.literal: Two hundred thousand ingots of salt duty notes were supplied for Yunnan military needs.
translations.idiomatic: 200,000 ingots of salt duty notes were supplied for Yunnan military needs.

sentences.zh: 命河南、湖廣、江西、甘肅行省誦《藏經》六百五十部，施鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Gansu branch secretariats were ordered to chant the Tripitaka in six hundred fifty sections and grant thirty thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Gansu branch secretariats were ordered to chant the Tripitaka in 650 sections and grant 30,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 知樞密院事闊徹伯、脫脫木兒，通政使只兒哈郎，翰林學士承旨教化的、伯顏也不幹，燕王宮相教化的、斡羅思，中政使尚家奴、禿烏臺，右阿速衛指揮使那海察、拜住，以謀變有罪，並棄市，籍其家。

translations.literal: Privy council administrator Kuochebo, Totuomuer, transmission commissioner Zhierhalang, Hanlin academician expositor Jiaohua, Bayan Bugan, Yan Wang palace director Jiaohua, Woluosi, central administration commissioner Shangjianu, Tuwutai, right Alan guard commander Nahacha, Baizhu — guilty of plotting rebellion, all were executed in the marketplace and their families were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Kuochebo, Totuomuer, transmission commissioner Zhierhalang, Hanlin academician expositor Jiaohua, Bayan Bugan, Yan Wang palace director Jiaohua, Woluosi, central administration commissioner Shangjianu, Tuwutai, right Alan guard commander Nahacha, Baizhu — guilty of plotting rebellion, all were executed in the marketplace and their families were registered.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，四川孛羅以蒙古漸丁軍五千往雲南。

translations.literal: On guimao day Boluo of Sichuan led five thousand Mongol gradually registered troops to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Boluo of Sichuan led 5,000 Mongol gradually registered troops to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，羅羅斯土官撒加伯合烏蒙蠻兵萬人攻建昌縣，雲南行省右丞躍裏帖木兒拒之，斬首四百餘級，四川軍亦敗撒加伯於蘆古驛。

translations.literal: On yisi day Luoluo native official Sajiabo joined Wumeng barbarian troops of ten thousand to attack Jianchang County; Yunnan Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Yolqi Temür resisted them, beheading over four hundred heads; Sichuan troops also defeated Sajiabo at Lugu Post Station.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Luoluo native official Sajiabo joined Wumeng barbarian troops of 10,000 to attack Jianchang County; Yunnan Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Yolqi Temür resisted them, beheading over 400 heads; Sichuan troops also defeated Sajiabo at Lugu Post Station.

sentences.zh: 丙午，朵思麻蒙古民饑，賑糧一月。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Duosima Mongol populace had famine; one month's grain was disbursed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Duosima Mongol populace had famine; 1 month's grain was disbursed in relief.

translations.idiomatic: Western-region prince Busein dispatched envoys to come to court in congratulation.

translations.idiomatic: Dadu relief-sale grain was increased by 50,000 shi.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhou and Dong'anzhou of Dadu great wind, rain, and hail damaged crops.

translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Princess Shouning died; her seal was taken back.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Jupiter encroached upon the Dixiu constellation.

translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan Route had hail that damaged crops.

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day princes Yangqietemür, Boluotai, Zhengjisi, Cha'aowuhan and others were granted gold, silver, and notes in graded amounts.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day an imperial command directed central secretariat and censorate to dispatch officials to Jiangzhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan branch secretariats to transfer and appoint officials below rank 3b.

sentences.zh: 大駕將還，敕上都兵馬司官二員，率兵士由偏嶺至明安巡邏，以防盜賊。

translations.literal: As the grand carriage was about to return, an edict ordered two Shangdu Military Horse Office officials to lead soldiers from Pianling to Ming'an to patrol, to guard against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: As the grand carriage was about to return, an edict ordered 2 Shangdu Military Horse Office officials to lead soldiers from Pianling to Ming'an to patrol, to guard against bandits.

sentences.zh: 市橐駝百、牛三百，充扈從屬軍之用。

translations.literal: One hundred camels and three hundred oxen were purchased at market to supply the accompanying attendant armies.
translations.idiomatic: 100 camels and 300 oxen were purchased at market to supply the accompanying attendant armies.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，忠翊衛左右屯田隕霜殺稼。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Zhongyi Guard left and right garrison fields — frost killed the grain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Zhongyi Guard left and right garrison fields — frost killed the grain.

sentences.zh: 籍鎖住、野裏牙等庫藏、田宅、奴仆、牧畜，給大承天護聖寺為永業。

translations.literal: Registers of Suochu, Yeliya, and others' treasuries, field estates, slaves and servants, and livestock were taken and given to Great Chengtian Huguo Temple as perpetual endowment.
translations.idiomatic: Registers of Suochu, Yeliya, and others' treasuries, field estates, slaves and servants, and livestock were taken and given to Great Chengtian Huguo Temple as perpetual endowment.

sentences.zh: 鑄黃金神仙符命印，賜掌全真教道士苗道一。

translations.literal: A golden Immortal Mandate Seal of Divine Command was cast and granted to Daoist Miao Daoyi, who headed the Complete Truth teaching.
translations.idiomatic: A golden Immortal Mandate Seal of Divine Command was cast and granted to Daoist Miao Daoyi, who headed the Complete Truth teaching.

sentences.zh: 己丑，立掌醫署，秩正五品。

translations.literal: On jichou day the Medical Superintendent Office was established, rank 5a.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Medical Superintendent Office was established, rank 5a.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以所籍野理牙宅為都督府公署。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Yeliya's residence that had been registered was made the metropolitan military commission public office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Yeliya's residence that had been registered was made the metropolitan military commission public office.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以陜西行臺御史中丞脫亦納為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Shaanxi Branch Censorate Vice Censor-in-Chief Tuoyina was made Central Secretariat Assistant Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Shaanxi Branch Censorate Vice Censor-in-Chief Tuoyina was made Central Secretariat Assistant Administrator.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒言：「趙世延向自言年老，屢乞致仕，臣等以聞，嘗有旨，世延舊人，宜與共政中書。

translations.literal: Yan Temür said: "Zhao Shiyan previously himself said he was old and repeatedly begged to retire; we reported; there was once an edict — Shiyan is an old associate, fit to govern together in the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür said: "Zhao Shiyan previously himself said he was old and repeatedly begged to retire; we reported; there was once an edict — Shiyan is an old associate, fit to govern together in the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 御史之言，不知前有旨也。

translations.literal: The censor's words — they did not know there was a prior edict."
translations.idiomatic: The censor's words — they did not know there was a prior edict."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「如御史言，世延固難任中書矣，其仍任以翰林、奎章之職。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "As the censor says, Shiyan indeed can hardly hold the Central Secretariat; let him still hold Hanlin and Kui Zhang posts."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "As the censor says, Shiyan indeed can hardly hold the Central Secretariat; let him still hold Hanlin and Kui Zhang posts."

sentences.zh: 」四川行省平章汪壽昌言：「雲南伯忽叛逆，興兵進討，調遣饋餉，皆壽昌領之。

translations.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor Wang Shouchang said: "Yunnan's Bo Hu rebelled; raising troops to attack — mobilizing and supplying provisions all fell to Shouchang.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor Wang Shouchang said: "Yunnan's Bo Hu rebelled; raising troops to attack — mobilizing and supplying provisions all fell to Shouchang.

sentences.zh: 頃以市馬、造器械、軍官俸給、軍士行糧，已給鈔十五萬錠。

translations.literal: Recently for purchasing horses, making weapons, officers' salaries, and soldiers' marching grain — already one hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes have been given.
translations.idiomatic: Recently for purchasing horses, making weapons, officers' salaries, and soldiers' marching grain — already 150,000 ingots of notes have been given.

sentences.zh: 今伯忽未及殄滅，而烏撒、烏蒙相繼為亂，大兵深入，去朝廷益遠，元請軍需，早乞頒降，從本省酌其緩急，便宜以行，庶不稽誤。

translations.literal: Now Bo Hu is not yet destroyed, yet Wusa and Wumeng successively rebelled; the great army penetrates deep, farther from court; repeatedly requesting military supplies — we early beg issuance and grant; let this province weigh urgency and expediently act, lest there be delay."
translations.idiomatic: Now Bo Hu is not yet destroyed, yet Wusa and Wumeng successively rebelled; the great army penetrates deep, farther from court; repeatedly requesting military supplies — we early beg issuance and grant; let this province weigh urgency and expediently act, lest there be delay."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 寧夏、奉元、鞏昌、鳳翔、大同、晉寧諸路屬縣隕霜殺稼。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties of Ningxia, Fengyuan, Gongchang, Fengxiang, Datong, and Jinning — frost killed the grain.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Ningxia, Fengyuan, Gongchang, Fengxiang, Datong, and Jinning — frost killed the grain.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以月魯帖木兒為大司徒。

translations.literal: On guisi day Yue'er Temür was made Grand Steward.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Yue'er Temür was made Grand Steward.

sentences.zh: 賜哈剌赤軍士鈔一萬錠、糧十萬石。

translations.literal: Harachi guardsmen were granted ten thousand ingots of notes and one hundred thousand shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Harachi guardsmen were granted 10,000 ingots of notes and 100,000 shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 察罕腦兒並東、西涼亭諸衛士九百五十人，人賜鈔五錠、糧二月；

translations.literal: Chagan Na'er and eastern and western Liangting guardsmen, nine hundred fifty persons — each granted five ingots of notes and two months' grain;
translations.idiomatic: Chagan Na'er and eastern and western Liangting guardsmen, 950 persons — each granted 5 ingots of notes and 2 months' grain;

sentences.zh: 朔漠軍士，人鈔三錠、布二匹、糧二月。

translations.literal: northern desert guardsmen — each three ingots of notes, two bolts of cloth, and two months' grain.
translations.idiomatic: northern desert guardsmen — each 3 ingots of notes, 2 bolts of cloth, and 2 months' grain.

sentences.zh: 命燕鐵木兒以鈔萬錠，分賜天歷初諸王、群臣死事之家。

translations.literal: Yan Temür was ordered with ten thousand ingots of notes to divide and grant to families of princes and ministers who died in service at the start of Tianli.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür was ordered with 10,000 ingots of notes to divide and grant to families of princes and ministers who died in service at the start of Tianli.

sentences.zh: 行樞密院言：「征戍雲南軍士二人逃歸，捕獲，法當死。

translations.literal: Mobile Privy Council said: "Two soldiers campaigning in Yunnan fled back and were captured — by law they should die."
translations.idiomatic: Mobile Privy Council said: "2 soldiers campaigning in Yunnan fled back and were captured — by law they should die."

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「如臨戰陣而逃，死宜也。

translations.literal: An edict: "If fleeing as when facing the battle line, death is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: An edict: "If fleeing as when facing the battle line, death is fitting.

sentences.zh: 非接戰而逃，輒當以死，何視人命之易耶？

translations.literal: If fleeing when not in contact with battle yet always sentenced to death — how can human life be held so cheap?
translations.idiomatic: If fleeing when not in contact with battle yet always sentenced to death — how can human life be held so cheap?

sentences.zh: 其杖而流之。

translations.literal: Flog and exile them."
translations.idiomatic: Flog and exile them."

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，大駕發上都。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the grand carriage departed Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the grand carriage departed Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 授阿憐帖木兒大司徒印。

translations.literal: Alian Temür was granted the Grand Steward seal.
translations.idiomatic: Alian Temür was granted the Grand Steward seal.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，甘肅平章政事乃馬臺封宣寧郡王，授以金印；

translations.literal: On wuxu day Gansu Associate Chancellor Naimatai was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanning Commandery and granted a gold seal;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Gansu Associate Chancellor Naimatai was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanning Commandery and granted a gold seal;

sentences.zh: 駙馬謹只兒封鄆國公，授以銀印；

translations.literal: imperial son-in-law Jinzhi'er was enfeoffed Duke of Yun State and granted a silver seal;
translations.idiomatic: imperial son-in-law Jinzhi'er was enfeoffed Duke of Yun State and granted a silver seal;

sentences.zh: 並知行樞密院事。

translations.literal: both were ordered concurrently to administer Mobile Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: both were ordered concurrently to administer Mobile Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 贈安南國王陳益稷儀同三司、湖廣行省平章政事，王爵如故，謚忠懿。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Annan King Chen Yiji Ceremonial Peer of Three Ranks and Huguang Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor, his kingly title as before, posthumous name Zhongyi.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously granted Annan King Chen Yiji Ceremonial Peer of Three Ranks and Huguang Branch Secretariat Associate Chancellor, his kingly title as before, posthumous name Zhongyi.

sentences.zh: 益稷在世祖時自其國來歸，遂授以國王，即居於漢陽府，天歷二年卒，至是加贈、謚。

translations.literal: Yiji during Emperor Shizu came from his state to submit; he was then granted king and dwelt in Hanyang Prefecture; he died in the second year of Tianli — now posthumous gifts and a posthumous name were added.
translations.idiomatic: Yiji during Emperor Shizu came from his state to submit; he was then granted king and dwelt in Hanyang Prefecture; he died in the 2nd year of Tianli — now posthumous gifts and a posthumous name were added.

sentences.zh: 庚子，魯王阿剌哥識裏所部三萬餘人告饑，賑鈔萬錠、糧二萬石。

translations.literal: On gengzi day more than thirty thousand persons under Lu Prince Alaqeshili reported famine; they were relieved with ten thousand ingots of notes and twenty thousand shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day more than 30,000 persons under Lu Prince Alaqeshili reported famine; they were relieved with 10,000 ingots of notes and 20,000 shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「內外佛寺三百六十七所，用金、銀、鈔、幣不貲，今國用不充，宜從裁省。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Inner and outer Buddhist temples number three hundred sixty-seven; they use gold, silver, notes, and silks beyond measure; now state expenditures are insufficient — reduction should follow."
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said: "Inner and outer Buddhist temples number 367; they use gold, silver, notes, and silks beyond measure; now state expenditures are insufficient — reduction should follow."

sentences.zh: 」命省人及宣政院臣裁減。

translations.literal: Secretariat personnel and Xuanzheng Court officials were ordered to reduce expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat personnel and Xuanzheng Court officials were ordered to reduce expenditures.

sentences.zh: 上都歲作佛事百六十五所，定為百四所，令有司永為歲例。

translations.literal: Shangdu's annual Buddhist rites at one hundred sixty-five sites were fixed at one hundred four; relevant offices were ordered to make this the perpetual annual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu's annual Buddhist rites at 165 sites were fixed at 104; relevant offices were ordered to make this the perpetual annual precedent.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，雲南使來報捷，遣使賜雲南、四川省臣、行樞密院臣以上尊。

translations.literal: On yisi day a Yunnan envoy reported victory; envoys were dispatched to grant Yunnan and Sichuan provincial officials and Mobile Privy Council officials upper libations.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day a Yunnan envoy reported victory; envoys were dispatched to grant Yunnan and Sichuan provincial officials and Mobile Privy Council officials upper libations.

sentences.zh: 丙午，諸王卜顏帖木兒請給鞍馬，願從諸軍擊雲南，帝嘉其意，從之。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Prince Boyan Temür requested saddles and horses and wished to follow the various armies against Yunnan; the Emperor commended his intent — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince Boyan Temür requested saddles and horses and wished to follow the various armies against Yunnan; the Emperor commended his intent — approved.

sentences.zh: 戊申，加封孔子父齊國公叔梁紇為啟聖王，母魯國太夫人顏氏為啟聖王夫人，顏子兗國復聖公，曾子郕國宗聖公，子思沂國述聖公，孟子鄒國亞聖公，河南伯程顥豫國公，伊陽伯程頤洛國公。

translations.literal: On wushen day Confucius's father Duke of Qi State Shuliang He was further enfeoffed King Qisheng; his mother Lady Yan, Grand Mistress of Lu State, was enfeoffed Consort of King Qisheng; Yan Hui, Duke of Yan State, Duke Fusheng; Zeng Shen, Duke of Zeng State, Duke Zongsheng; Zisi, Duke of Yi State, Duke Shusheng; Mencius, Duke of Zou State, Duke Yasheng; Cheng Hao, Earl of Henan, Duke of Yu State; and Cheng Yi, Earl of Yiyang, Duke of Luo State.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Confucius's father Duke of Qi State Shuliang He was further enfeoffed King Qisheng; his mother Lady Yan, Grand Mistress of Lu State, was enfeoffed Consort of King Qisheng; Yan Hui, Duke of Yan State, Duke Fusheng; Zeng Shen, Duke of Zeng State, Duke Zongsheng; Zisi, Duke of Yi State, Duke Shusheng; Mencius, Duke of Zou State, Duke Yasheng; Cheng Hao, Earl of Henan, Duke of Yu State; and Cheng Yi, Earl of Yiyang, Duke of Luo State.

sentences.zh: 羅羅斯土官撒加伯及阿陋土官阿剌、裏州土官德益兵八千撤毀棧道，遣把事曹通潛結西番，欲據大渡河進寇建昌。

translations.literal: Luoluo native official Sajabo, Alou native official Ala, and Lizhou native official Deyi — eight thousand troops — destroyed plank roads; they dispatched steward Cao Tong to secretly ally with Western Tibetan forces, intending to hold the Great River crossing and invade Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Luoluo native official Sajabo, Alou native official Ala, and Lizhou native official Deyi — 8,000 troops — destroyed plank roads; they dispatched steward Cao Tong to secretly ally with Western Tibetan forces, intending to hold the Great River crossing and invade Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 四川行省調碉門安撫司軍七百人，成都、保寧、順慶、廣安諸屯兵千人，令萬戶周戡統領，直抵羅羅斯界，以控扼西番及諸蠻部。

translations.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat mobilized seven hundred troops of the Diaomen Pacification Commission and one thousand garrison soldiers of Chengdu, Baoning, Shunqing, and Guangan, under Wanhu Zhou Kan, straight to the Luoluo border, to control Western Tibetan forces and various barbarian divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat mobilized 700 troops of the Diaomen Pacification Commission and 1,000 garrison soldiers of Chengdu, Baoning, Shunqing, and Guangan, under Wanhu Zhou Kan, straight to the Luoluo border, to control Western Tibetan forces and various barbarian divisions.

sentences.zh: 又遣成都、順慶二翼萬戶昝定遠等，以軍五千同邛部知州馬伯所部蠻兵，會周戡等，從便道共討之，發成都沙糖戶二百九十人防遏敘州。

translations.literal: Chengdu and Shunqing two wing Wanhu Zan Dingyuan and others were also dispatched with five thousand troops together with Qiongzhou Prefecture prefect Ma Bo's barbarian troops to join Zhou Kan and the rest, by a convenient route to attack jointly; two hundred ninety Chengdu sugar-tax households were dispatched to defend against Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu and Shunqing 2 wing Wanhu Zan Dingyuan and others were also dispatched with 5,000 troops together with Qiongzhou Prefecture prefect Ma Bo's barbarian troops to join Zhou Kan and the rest, by a convenient route to attack jointly; 290 Chengdu sugar-tax households were dispatched to defend against Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 征重慶、夔州逃亡軍八百人赴成都。

translations.literal: Eight hundred escaped soldiers from Chongqing and Kuizhou were recruited and sent to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: 800 escaped soldiers from Chongqing and Kuizhou were recruited and sent to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 廣西徭於國安率千五百人寇修仁、荔浦等縣，廣西元帥府發兵捕之，賊眾潰走，生擒國安。

translations.literal: Guangxi Yao leader Yu Guo'an led one thousand five hundred men to raid Xiuren, Lipu, and other counties; Guangxi Marshal's Office dispatched troops to capture them; the bandits scattered and fled; Guo'an was captured alive.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi Yao leader Yu Guo'an led 1,500 men to raid Xiuren, Lipu, and other counties; Guangxi Marshal's Office dispatched troops to capture them; the bandits scattered and fled; Guo'an was captured alive.

sentences.zh: 大都、太寧、保定、益都諸屬縣及京畿諸衛、大司農諸屯水，沒田八十餘頃。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties of Dadu, Taining, Baoding, and Yidu and capital-region various guards and Grand Agriculture garrison fields — floodwater submerged more than eighty qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Dadu, Taining, Baoding, and Yidu and capital-region various guards and Grand Agriculture garrison fields — floodwater submerged more than 80 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 杭州、常州、慶元、紹興、鎮江、寧國諸路及常德、安慶、池州、荊門諸屬縣皆水，沒田一萬三千五百八十餘頃。

translations.literal: Hangzhou, Changzhou, Qingyuan, Shaoxing, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo routes and subordinate counties of Changde, Anqing, Chizhou, and Jingmen all had floodwater that submerged more than thirteen thousand five hundred eighty qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou, Changzhou, Qingyuan, Shaoxing, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo routes and subordinate counties of Changde, Anqing, Chizhou, and Jingmen all had floodwater that submerged more than 13,580 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 松江、平江、嘉興、湖州等路水，漂民廬，沒田三萬六千六百餘頃，饑民四十萬五千五百七十餘戶，詔江浙行省以入粟補官鈔三千錠及勸率富人出粟十萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Songjiang, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou routes had floodwater that swept away people's houses and submerged more than thirty-six thousand six hundred qing of fields; more than four hundred five thousand five hundred seventy households were starving; an edict ordered Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat to use three thousand ingots of grain-for-office notes and to encourage wealthy persons to contribute one hundred thousand shi of grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Songjiang, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou routes had floodwater that swept away people's houses and submerged more than 36,600 qing of fields; more than 405,570 households were starving; an edict ordered Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat to use 3,000 ingots of grain-for-office notes and to encourage wealthy persons to contribute 100,000 shi of grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 寶慶、衡、永諸處，田生青蟲，食禾稼。

translations.literal: Baoxing, Heng, and Yong areas — fields sprouted green worms that ate the grain.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing, Heng, and Yong areas — fields sprouted green worms that ate the grain.

sentences.zh: 冠州郁世復、大都趙祥及弟英，以孝行旌其門。

translations.literal: Yu Shifu of Guanzhou, Zhao Xiang of Dadu, and his younger brother Ying — for filial conduct their gates were honored.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shifu of Guanzhou, Zhao Xiang of Dadu, and his younger brother Ying — for filial conduct their gates were honored.

sentences.zh: 大都愛祖丁、塔術，漷州劉仲溫，以輸米賑貧旌其門。

translations.literal: Aizu Ding and Tasu of Dadu and Liu Zhongwen of Huozhou — for contributing grain to relieve the poor their gates were honored.
translations.idiomatic: Aizu Ding and Tasu of Dadu and Liu Zhongwen of Huozhou — for contributing grain to relieve the poor their gates were honored.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，河南府路新安、沔池等十五驛饑疫，人給粟、馬給芻粟各一月。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengxu day, fifteen relay stations including Xin'an and Mianchi in Henan Prefecture Route had famine and epidemic; people were each given one month's grain and horses one month's fodder.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on gengxu day, 15 relay stations including Xin'an and Mianchi in Henan Prefecture Route had famine and epidemic; people were each given 1 month's grain and horses 1 month's fodder.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，雲南躍裏鐵木兒以兵屯建昌，執羅羅斯把事曹通斬之。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Yueli Temür of Yunnan garrisoned troops at Jianchang, captured Luoluo steward Cao Tong, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Yueli Temür of Yunnan garrisoned troops at Jianchang, captured Luoluo steward Cao Tong, and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，北邊諸王月即別遣使來京師。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Prince Yuejibie of the northern border dispatched an envoy to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Prince Yuejibie of the northern border dispatched an envoy to the capital.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒由西道田獵未至，詔以機務至重，遣使趣召之。

translations.literal: Yan Temür, hunting by the western route, had not yet arrived; an edict said state affairs were of the utmost weight and envoys were dispatched to urge his summons.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür, hunting by the western route, had not yet arrived; an edict said state affairs were of the utmost weight and envoys were dispatched to urge his summons.

sentences.zh: 己未，大駕至京師，勞遣人士還營。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the grand carriage reached the capital; laborers sent out were rewarded and sent back to their camps.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the grand carriage reached the capital; laborers sent out were rewarded and sent back to their camps.

sentences.zh: 有言蔚州廣靈縣地產銀者，詔中書、太禧院遣人蒞其事，歲所得銀歸大承天護聖寺。

translations.literal: Someone reported that Guangling County in Weizhou produced silver; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and Grand Blessings Court to dispatch persons to oversee the matter; silver obtained each year was to go to Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Someone reported that Guangling County in Weizhou produced silver; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and Grand Blessings Court to dispatch persons to oversee the matter; silver obtained each year was to go to Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以世祖是月生，命京師率僧百七十人作佛事七日。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, because Emperor Shizu was born in this month, the capital was ordered to lead one hundred seventy monks in seven days of Buddhist rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, because Emperor Shizu was born in this month, the capital was ordered to lead 170 monks in 7 days of Buddhist rites.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣請立燕王為皇太子，帝曰：「朕子尚幼，非裕宗為燕王時比，俟燕帖木兒至，共議之。

translations.literal: Censorate officials requested establishing the Yan Prince as crown prince; the Emperor said: "My son is still young — not comparable to when Yuzong was Yan Prince; wait until Yan Temür arrives and deliberate jointly."
