sentences.zh: 至是，末魯孫一十五狗驛，狗多餓死，賑糧兩月，狗死者，給鈔補市之。

translations.literal: At this time, Melursun's fifteen-dog relay — many dogs starved to death; two months' relief grain was given; for dead dogs, notes were given to make up purchases in the market.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, Melursun's fifteen-dog relay — many dogs starved to death; 2 months' relief grain was given; for dead dogs, notes were given to make up purchases in the market.

sentences.zh: 辰州萬戶圖格裏不花母石抹氏以誌節，漳州龍溪縣陳必達以孝行，並旌其門。

translations.literal: Shi Mo of Wanhu Tegelibuqhua's mother in Chenzhou for recorded integrity, and Chen Bida of Longxi County, Zhangzhou, for filial conduct — both had their gates honored.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Mo of Wanhu Tegelibuqhua's mother in Chenzhou for recorded integrity, and Chen Bida of Longxi County, Zhangzhou, for filial conduct — both had their gates honored.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申朔，降璽書申飭衍聖公崇奉孔子廟事。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, wushen new moon — an imperial-seal edict was sent down admonishing the Duke Who Extends Sagacity to revere and serve Confucius temple affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, wushen new moon — an imperial-seal edict was sent down admonishing the Duke Who Extends Sagacity to revere and serve Confucius temple affairs.

sentences.zh: 賜雲南行省參政忽都沙三珠虎符。

translations.literal: A three-bead tiger tally was granted to Huguang Branch Secretariat associate administrator Hudu Sha of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: A 3-bead tiger tally was granted to Huguang Branch Secretariat associate administrator Hudu Sha of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命湖廣行省給諸王雲都思鐵木兒幣百匹，以賞將士捕徭賊有功者。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to give Prince Yundu Temür one hundred bolts of currency cloth to reward officers and soldiers who had merit in capturing Yao bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to give Prince Yundu Temür 100 bolts of currency cloth to reward officers and soldiers who had merit in capturing Yao bandits.

sentences.zh: 壬子，諸王、大臣復請立燕王為皇太子，帝曰：「卿等所言誠是。

translations.literal: On renzi day princes and great ministers again requested establishing the Yan prince as crown prince; the Emperor said: "What you say is indeed correct.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day princes and great ministers again requested establishing the Yan prince as crown prince; the Emperor said: "What you say is indeed correct.

sentences.zh: 但燕王尚幼，恐其識慮未弘，不克負荷，徐議之未晚也。

translations.literal: But the Yan prince is still young; I fear his understanding and deliberation are not yet broad and he cannot bear the burden — to deliberate later is not too late."
translations.idiomatic: But the Yan prince is still young; I fear his understanding and deliberation are not yet broad and he cannot bear the burden — to deliberate later is not too late."

sentences.zh: 」立宣忠扈衛親軍都萬戶營於大都北，市民田百三十餘頃賜之。

translations.literal: The Loyal and Faithful Imperial Guard Command wanhu camp was established north of Dadu; one hundred thirty-odd qing of civilian fields in the city market were granted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Loyal and Faithful Imperial Guard Command wanhu camp was established north of Dadu; 130-odd qing of civilian fields in the city market were granted it.

sentences.zh: 戊午，致齋於大明殿。

translations.literal: On wuwu day purification was performed at the Great Brightness Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day purification was performed at the Great Brightness Hall.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣亞獻官中書右丞相燕鐵木兒、終獻官貼木爾補化率諸執事告廟，請以太祖皇帝配享南郊。

translations.literal: On jiwei day secondary offering officer central secretariat right chancellor Yan Temür and final offering officer Timur Buqa led the various officiants to announce at the temple, requesting Taizu Emperor as co-attendant at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day secondary offering officer central secretariat right chancellor Yan Temür and final offering officer Timur Buqa led the various officiants to announce at the temple, requesting Taizu Emperor as co-attendant at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚申，出次郊宮。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the Emperor moved out to the suburban palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor moved out to the suburban palace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，帝服大裘、袞冕，祀昊天上帝於南郊，以太祖皇帝配，禮成，是日大駕還宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the Emperor wore great fur robe and twelve-symbol regalia and sacrificed to Supreme Heaven God at the southern suburb, with Taizu Emperor as co-attendant; when the rite was completed, that day the great procession returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Emperor wore great fur robe and twelve-symbol regalia and sacrificed to Supreme Heaven God at the southern suburb, with Taizu Emperor as co-attendant; when the rite was completed, that day the great procession returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以奉元驛馬瘠死，命陜西行省給鈔三千錠補市之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, because Fengyuan relay horses were lean and died, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to give three thousand ingots of notes to make up purchases in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because Fengyuan relay horses were lean and died, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to give 3,000 ingots of notes to make up purchases in the market.

sentences.zh: 木納火失溫所居諸牧人三千戶、瀕黃河所居鷹坊五千戶，各賑糧兩月。

translations.literal: Three thousand households of herders dwelling at Muna Qoshiyun and five thousand households of the falconry bureau dwelling along the Yellow River — each was given two months' relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: 3,000 households of herders dwelling at Muna Qoshiyun and 5,000 households of the falconry bureau dwelling along the Yellow River — each was given 2 months' relief grain.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，廣西徭賊寇橫州及永淳縣，敕廣西元帥府率兵捕之。

translations.literal: On yichou day Guangxi Yao bandits raided Heng Prefecture and Yongchun County; Guangxi Marshal's Office was edicted to lead troops to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Guangxi Yao bandits raided Heng Prefecture and Yongchun County; Guangxi Marshal's Office was edicted to lead troops to capture them.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣言：「每歲大駕幸上都，發各衛軍士千五百人扈從，又發諸衛漢軍萬五千人駐山後，蒙古軍三千人駐官山，以守關梁。

translations.literal: Privy council officials said: "Each year when the great procession visits Shangdu, one thousand five hundred guard soldiers of each guard are mobilized as escort; further, fifteen thousand Han troops of the various guards are mobilized to encamp behind the mountains, and three thousand Mongol troops encamp at Guanshan to guard passes and bridges.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council officials said: "Each year when the great procession visits Shangdu, 1,500 guard soldiers of each guard are mobilized as escort; further, 15,000 Han troops of the various guards are mobilized to encamp behind the mountains, and 3,000 Mongol troops encamp at Guanshan to guard passes and bridges.

sentences.zh: 乞如舊數調遣，以俟來年。

translations.literal: We beg to mobilize according to the former numbers, to await next year."
translations.idiomatic: We beg to mobilize according to the former numbers, to await next year."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 辛未，烏蒙路土官阿朝歸順，遣其通事阿累等貢方物。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Wumeng Route native official Azhao submitted and sent his interpreter Alei and others to present tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Wumeng Route native official Azhao submitted and sent his interpreter Alei and others to present tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬申，御史臺臣言：「內外官吏令家人受財，以其幹名犯義，罪止四十七、解任。

translations.literal: On renshen day censorate officials said: "Civil and military officials within and without who let their family members receive bribes — though it violates right conduct in their name, punishment is only the fifty-seven-stroke rule and removal from office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day censorate officials said: "Civil and military officials within and without who let their family members receive bribes — though it violates right conduct in their name, punishment is only the 57-stroke rule and removal from office.

sentences.zh: 今貪汙者緣此犯法愈多，請依十二章計贓多寡論罪。

translations.literal: Now corrupt men increasingly offend the law by this; we request that according to the Twelve Chapters, guilt be determined by the amount of bribes."
translations.idiomatic: Now corrupt men increasingly offend the law by this; we request that according to the Twelve Chapters, guilt be determined by the amount of bribes."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，敕：「累朝宮分官署，凡文移無得稱皇后，止稱某位下娘子。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day edict: "Palace encampment offices of successive reigns — in all documents they may not address the empress; they may only address a certain lady below rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day edict: "Palace encampment offices of successive reigns — in all documents they may not address the empress; they may only address a certain lady below rank.

sentences.zh: 其委用官屬，並由中書擬聞。

translations.literal: All officials they employ shall be proposed and reported by the central secretariat."
translations.idiomatic: All officials they employ shall be proposed and reported by the central secretariat."

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，改打捕鷹坊總管府為仁虞都總管府。

translations.literal: On yihai day the Hawk-catching Falconry Metropolitan Commission was changed to the Benevolent Bliss Capital Metropolitan Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Hawk-catching Falconry Metropolitan Commission was changed to the Benevolent Bliss Capital Metropolitan Commission.

sentences.zh: 知樞密院事撒敦、宣徽使唐其勢，並賜答剌罕之號。

translations.literal: Privy council administrator Sadun and Xuanhui commissioner Tangqishi were both granted the Darqan title.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Sadun and Xuanhui commissioner Tangqishi were both granted the Darqan title.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「近討雲南，已給鈔二十萬錠為軍需，今費用已盡，鎮西武靖王搠思班及行省、行院復求鈔如前數。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "In the recent campaign against Yunnan, two hundred thousand ingots of notes were already given as military supplies; the outlay is now exhausted, and Western Pacification Martial Pacification Prince Shuosiban together with branch secretariat and mobile privy council again request notes in the former amount.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "In the recent campaign against Yunnan, 200,000 ingots of notes were already given as military supplies; the outlay is now exhausted, and Western Pacification Martial Pacification Prince Shuosiban together with branch secretariat and mobile privy council again request notes in the former amount.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，方當進討之際，宜依所請給之。

translations.literal: We deliberated: at the time when advance attack is imminent, it is fitting to grant as requested."
translations.idiomatic: We deliberated: at the time when advance attack is imminent, it is fitting to grant as requested."

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「可。

translations.literal: Edict: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "Approved."

sentences.zh: 」賜伯夷、叔齊廟額曰聖清，歲春秋祠以少牢。

translations.literal: The temple plaque of Boyi and Shuqi was granted the title Sagely Purity; in spring and autumn of each year they are sacrificed to with the lesser victim.
translations.idiomatic: The temple plaque of Boyi and Shuqi was granted the title Sagely Purity; in spring and autumn of each year they are sacrificed to with the lesser victim.

sentences.zh: 遣使趣四川、雲南行省兵進討。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to urge Sichuan and Yunnan branch secretariat troops to advance in attack.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to urge Sichuan and Yunnan branch secretariat troops to advance in attack.

sentences.zh: 於是四川行省平章塔出引兵由永寧，左丞孛羅引兵由青山、茫部並進，陳兵周泥驛，及祿余等戰，殺蠻兵三百餘人。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tacho led troops by Yongning; left vice chancellor Boluo led troops by Qingshan and Mangbu advancing together; troops were arrayed at Zhou'ni Post Station and fought Luoyu and others, killing over three hundred barbarian troops.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tacho led troops by Yongning; left vice chancellor Boluo led troops by Qingshan and Mangbu advancing together; troops were arrayed at Zhou'ni Post Station and fought Luoyu and others, killing over 300 barbarian troops.

sentences.zh: 祿余眾潰，即奪其關隘，以導順元諸軍。

translations.literal: Luoyu's forces were routed; they immediately seized his passes and barriers to guide Shunyuan troops.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyu's forces were routed; they immediately seized his passes and barriers to guide Shunyuan troops.

sentences.zh: 時雲南行省平章乞住等俱失期不至。

translations.literal: At that time Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu and others all failed to arrive by the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu and others all failed to arrive by the deadline.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，命中書賑糶糧十萬石，濟京師貧民。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengchen day the central secretariat was ordered to sell relief grain of one hundred thousand shi to aid the capital's poor.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on gengchen day the central secretariat was ordered to sell relief grain of 100,000 shi to aid the capital's poor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，御史臺臣言：「陜西行省左丞怯列，坐受人僮奴一人及鸚鵡，請論如律。

translations.literal: On xinsi day censorate officials said: "Shaanxi Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Qielie, having accepted from a man one bondservant and a parrot — we request judgment according to law."
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day censorate officials said: "Shaanxi Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Qielie, having accepted from a man 1 bondservant and a parrot — we request judgment according to law."

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「位至宰執，食國厚祿，猶受人生口，理宜罪之。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Having reached chancellor rank and eating the state's thick salary, yet still accepting living persons from men — by reason he ought to be guilty.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Having reached chancellor rank and eating the state's thick salary, yet still accepting living persons from men — by reason he ought to be guilty.

sentences.zh: 便鸚鵡微物，以是論贓，失於太苛，其從重者議罪。

translations.literal: As for a parrot, a trifling thing — to treat this as bribery judgment would err on excessive severity; let the heavier matter determine guilt.
translations.idiomatic: As for a parrot, a trifling thing — to treat this as bribery judgment would err on excessive severity; let the heavier matter determine guilt.

sentences.zh: 今後凡饋禽鳥者，勿以贓論，著為令。

translations.literal: Hereafter for all who present birds, do not treat as bribes; establish this as regulation."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter for all who present birds, do not treat as bribes; establish this as regulation."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，賑上都灤河駐冬各宮分怯憐口萬五千七百戶糧二萬石。

translations.literal: On guimao day grain of twenty thousand shi was relieved to fifteen thousand seven hundred qielian households of the various palace encampments wintering along the Luan River at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day grain of 20,000 shi was relieved to 15,700 qielian households of the various palace encampments wintering along the Luan River at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，熒惑退犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Mars withdrew after violating the Ghost Lodging.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Mars withdrew after violating the Ghost Lodging.

sentences.zh: 命帝師率西僧作佛事，內外凡八所，以是日始，歲終罷。

translations.literal: The Imperial Preceptor was ordered to lead western monks in performing Buddhist rites — eight places within and without in total — beginning this day and ending at year's end.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Preceptor was ordered to lead western monks in performing Buddhist rites — 8 places within and without in total — beginning this day and ending at year's end.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Venus violated the Rampart Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus violated the Rampart Formation.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「至元間，安豐、安慶、廬州等路有未附籍戶千四百三十六，世祖命以其歲賦賜床兀兒。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "During the Zhiyuan period, Anfeng, Anqing, Luzhou and other routes had one thousand four hundred thirty-six households not yet attached to registers; Shizu ordered their yearly tax levies granted to Chuangwu'er.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "During the Zhiyuan period, Anfeng, Anqing, Luzhou and other routes had 1,436 households not yet attached to registers; Shizu ordered their yearly tax levies granted to Chuangwu'er.

sentences.zh: 後既附籍，所輸歲賦皆入官，別令萬億庫歲給以鈔二百錠。

translations.literal: Later they were attached to registers; the yearly levies submitted all entered government coffers, and separately the Wanyi Treasury yearly gave two hundred ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Later they were attached to registers; the yearly levies submitted all entered government coffers, and separately the Wanyi Treasury yearly gave 200 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 今乞停所給鈔，復以其戶還賜床兀兒之子燕鐵木兒。

translations.literal: Now we beg to stop the notes granted and again restore those households as grant to Chuangwu'er's son Yan Temür."
translations.idiomatic: Now we beg to stop the notes granted and again restore those households as grant to Chuangwu'er's son Yan Temür."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 羅羅斯撒加伯、烏撒阿答等合諸蠻萬五千人攻建昌，躍裏鐵木兒等引兵追戰於木托山下，敗之，斬首五百餘級。

translations.literal: Luoluo Sajiabo of Luolosi, Ada of Wusa, and others jointly led fifteen thousand barbarians to attack Jianchang; Yueli Temür and others led troops in pursuit to battle below Mount Muto, defeated them, and beheaded over five hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Luoluo Sajiabo of Luolosi, Ada of Wusa, and others jointly led 15,000 barbarians to attack Jianchang; Yueli Temür and others led troops in pursuit to battle below Mount Muto, defeated them, and beheaded over 500 heads.

sentences.zh: 賑襄、鄧畏兀民被西兵害者六十三戶，戶給鈔十五錠、米二石；

translations.literal: Sixty-three households of Hui and Deng Uighur people harmed by western troops — each household was given fifteen ingots of notes and two shi of rice;
translations.idiomatic: 63 households of Hui and Deng Uighur people harmed by western troops — each household was given 15 ingots of notes and 2 shi of rice;

sentences.zh: 被西兵掠者五百七十七戶，戶給鈔五錠、米二石。

translations.literal: Five hundred seventy-seven households plundered by western troops — each household was given five ingots of notes and two shi of rice.
translations.idiomatic: 577 households plundered by western troops — each household was given 5 ingots of notes and 2 shi of rice.

sentences.zh: 廣西廉訪司言：「今討叛徭，各行省官將兵二萬人，皆屯駐靜江，遷延不進，曠日持久，恐失事機。

translations.literal: Guangxi surveillance commission said: "In the present campaign against rebellious Yao, branch secretariat officials leading twenty thousand troops are all encamped at Jingjiang, delaying and not advancing — days drag on for long, and I fear the opportunity will be lost."
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi surveillance commission said: "In the present campaign against rebellious Yao, branch secretariat officials leading 20,000 troops are all encamped at Jingjiang, delaying and not advancing — days drag on for long, and I fear the opportunity will be lost."

sentences.zh: 」詔遣使趣之。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched envoys to urge them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched envoys to urge them.

sentences.zh: 知樞密院事燕不憐，請依舊制全給鷹坊芻粟，使毋貧乏。

translations.literal: Privy council administrator Yanbulin requested that according to the old system falconry bureau fodder grain be fully supplied so they would not suffer want.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Yanbulin requested that according to the old system falconry bureau fodder grain be fully supplied so they would not suffer want.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「國用皆百姓所供，當量入為出，朕豈以鷹坊失所，重困吾民哉？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "State expenditures all come from what the common people supply — expenditures should be measured against income; how could We, for the falconry bureau's loss, heavily burden Our people?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "State expenditures all come from what the common people supply — expenditures should be measured against income; how could We, for the falconry bureau's loss, heavily burden Our people?"

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: Not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Not approved.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以闊闊臺知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Kuokuotai was made privy council administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Kuokuotai was made privy council administrator.

sentences.zh: 給山東鹽課鈔三千錠，賑曹州濟陰等縣饑民。

translations.literal: Three thousand ingots of Shandong salt duty notes were given to relieve famine victims in Jiyin and other counties of Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: 3,000 ingots of Shandong salt duty notes were given to relieve famine victims in Jiyin and other counties of Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以臨江、吉安兩路天源延聖寺田千頃所入租稅，隸太禧宗禋院。

translations.literal: On guisi day the rent and tax yielded by one thousand qing of Tianyuan Yansheng Monastery fields in Linjiang and Ji'an two routes was made subordinate to the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Court.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the rent and tax yielded by 1,000 qing of Tianyuan Yansheng Monastery fields in Linjiang and Ji'an 2 routes was made subordinate to the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Court.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立打捕鷹坊紅花總管府於遼陽行省，秩四品。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the Hawk-catching Falconry Safflower Metropolitan Commission was established in Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, rank 4b.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Hawk-catching Falconry Safflower Metropolitan Commission was established in Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, rank 4b.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，征河南行省民間自實田土糧稅，不通舟楫之處得以鈔代輸。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the land and grain tax of voluntarily declared fields among the people of Henan Branch Secretariat was levied; in places not accessible by boat transport, submission in notes was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the land and grain tax of voluntarily declared fields among the people of Henan Branch Secretariat was levied; in places not accessible by boat transport, submission in notes was permitted.

sentences.zh: 命陜西行省賑河州蒙古屯田衛士糧兩月。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve two months' grain to Mongol colony field guard soldiers at Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve 2 months' grain to Mongol colony field guard soldiers at Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命司天監翙星。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe the comet.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe the comet.

sentences.zh: 丙午，恩州諸王按灰，坐擊傷巡檢張恭，杖六十七，謫還廣寧王所部充軍役。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Prince of En Anhui, for beating and injuring inspector Zhang Gong, was caned fifty-seven strokes and banished back to Prince of Guangning's division for military service.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince of En Anhui, for beating and injuring inspector Zhang Gong, was caned 57 strokes and banished back to Prince of Guangning's division for military service.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，遣伯顏等以將立燕王阿剌忒納答剌為皇太子，告祭於郊、廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wushen day — Bayan and others were dispatched because the Yan prince Alaqtenashiri was about to be established as crown prince to announce sacrifices at the suburban altar and temples.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wushen day — Bayan and others were dispatched because the Yan prince Alaqtenashiri was about to be established as crown prince to announce sacrifices at the suburban altar and temples.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以董仲舒從祀孔子廟，位列七十子之下。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Dong Zhongshu was granted associate sacrifice at the Confucius temple, ranking below the Seventy Disciples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Dong Zhongshu was granted associate sacrifice at the Confucius temple, ranking below the Seventy Disciples.

sentences.zh: 國子生積分及等者，省、臺、集賢院、奎章閣官同考試，中式者以等第試官，不中者復入學肄業。

translations.literal: National University students who accumulated full credits and grades — secretariat, censorate, Imperial Academy, and Kuizhang Pavilion officials jointly examined them; those who passed were tested for office by grade; those who failed returned to study.
translations.idiomatic: National University students who accumulated full credits and grades — secretariat, censorate, Imperial Academy, and Kuizhang Pavilion officials jointly examined them; those who passed were tested for office by grade; those who failed returned to study.

sentences.zh: 以粟十萬石，米、豆各十五萬石，給河北諸路牧官馬之家，宣忠扈衛斡羅思屯田，給牛、種、農具。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand shi of millet, and fifteen thousand shi each of rice and beans, were given to horse-breeding official families of Hebei routes; the Loyal and Faithful Imperial Guard Alan colony fields were given cattle, seed, and farm implements.
translations.idiomatic: 100,000 shi of millet, and 15,000 shi each of rice and beans, were given to horse-breeding official families of Hebei routes; the Loyal and Faithful Imperial Guard Alan colony fields were given cattle, seed, and farm implements.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，立燕王阿剌忒納答剌為皇太子，詔天下。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the Yan prince Alaqtenashiri was established as crown prince; proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Yan prince Alaqtenashiri was established as crown prince; proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，西域軍士居永平、灤州、豐閏、玉田者，人給鈔三錠、布二匹、糧兩月。

translations.literal: On jiayin day western route soldiers dwelling at Yongping, Luanzhou, Fengyun, and Yutian — each man was given three ingots of notes, two bolts of cloth, and two months' grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day western route soldiers dwelling at Yongping, Luanzhou, Fengyun, and Yutian — each man was given 3 ingots of notes, 2 bolts of cloth, and 2 months' grain.

sentences.zh: 監察御史言：「昔裕宗由燕邸而正儲位，世祖擇耆舊老臣如王颙、姚燧、蕭等為之師、保、賓客。

translations.literal: Supervising censors said: "Formerly Prince of Yu, having the Yan residence, was properly established in the heir's position; Shizu selected aged and venerable old ministers such as Wang Yong, Yao Sui, Xiao Huan, and others as his tutor, protector, and guests.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censors said: "Formerly Prince of Yu, having the Yan residence, was properly established in the heir's position; Shizu selected aged and venerable old ministers such as Wang Yong, Yao Sui, Xiao Huan, and others as his tutor, protector, and guests.

sentences.zh: 今皇太子仁孝聰睿，出自天成，誠宜慎選德望老成、學行純正者，俾之輔導於左右，以宏養正之功，實宗社生民之福也。

translations.literal: Now the crown prince is benevolent, filial, intelligent, and perceptive, endowed by nature; it is truly fitting to carefully select those of virtue and seniority, of pure learning and conduct, and place them at his left and right to nurture rectitude — this is truly the fortune of the altars of state and the living people."
translations.idiomatic: Now the crown prince is benevolent, filial, intelligent, and perceptive, endowed by nature; it is truly fitting to carefully select those of virtue and seniority, of pure learning and conduct, and place them at his left and right to nurture rectitude — this is truly the fortune of the altars of state and the living people."

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納其言。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and adopted their words.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised and adopted their words.

sentences.zh: 詔：「龍翔集慶寺工役、佛事，江南行臺悉給之。

translations.literal: An edict: "Labor and Buddhist services for Longxiang Jiqing Temple — the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat shall fully supply them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict: "Labor and Buddhist services for Longxiang Jiqing Temple — the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat shall fully supply them.

sentences.zh: 」戊午，以十月郊祀禮成，帝御大明殿受文武百官朝賀，大赦天下。

translations.literal: " On wuwu day, because the tenth-month suburban sacrifice rites were completed, the Emperor presided in the Great Brightness Hall and received the civil and military officials' congratulatory audience; a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuwu day, because the tenth-month suburban sacrifice rites were completed, the Emperor presided in the Great Brightness Hall and received the civil and military officials' congratulatory audience; a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，知樞密院事闊闊臺兼大都留守。

translations.literal: On guihai day, privy council administrator Kuokuotai was made concurrent Dadu garrison commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, privy council administrator Kuokuotai was made concurrent Dadu garrison commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣集賢侍讀學士珠遘詣真定，以明年正月二十日祀睿宗及後於玉華宮之神御殿。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Academician Reader of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Zhu Gou was dispatched to Zhending to sacrifice to Ruizong and the empress on the twentieth day of the first month of the coming year at the spirit-shrine hall of Yuhua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Academician Reader of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Zhu Gou was dispatched to Zhending to sacrifice to Ruizong and the empress on the 20th day of the first month of the coming year at the spirit-shrine hall of Yuhua Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命西僧於興聖、光天宮十六所作佛事。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at sixteen halls of the Xingsheng and Guangtian palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at 16 halls of the Xingsheng and Guangtian palaces.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔宣忠扈衛親軍都萬戶府：「凡立營司境內所屬山林川澤，其鳥獸魚鱉悉供內膳，諸獵捕者坐罪。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, an edict to the Xuanzhong Imperial Guard Army Commander-in-Chief's Office: "Within the territory subordinate to the encampment administration, all mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes — their birds, beasts, fish, and turtles shall all be supplied to the inner commissary; any who hunt or catch them shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，御史中丞和尚坐受婦人為賂，遇赦原罪。

translations.literal: " On jiaxu day, associate censor-in-chief Heshang was charged with accepting a bribe from a woman; encountering the amnesty, the original crime was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiaxu day, associate censor-in-chief Heshang was charged with accepting a bribe from a woman; encountering the amnesty, the original crime was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 監察御史言：「和尚所為貪縱，有汙臺綱，罪雖見原，理宜追奪所受制命，禁錮元籍終其身。

translations.literal: A supervising censor said: "Heshang's conduct was greedy and indulgent, defiling censorate standards; though the crime has been pardoned, it is proper to strip him of the commission documents conferred on him and confine him to his original register for life.

sentences.zh: 」臺臣以聞，制可。

sentences.zh: 敕各行省：「凡遇邊防有警，許令便宜發兵，事緩則驛聞。

translations.literal: An order to the branch secretariats: "Whenever the border defenses have an alert, they are permitted to dispatch troops at discretion; if the matter is not urgent, they shall report by relay.
translations.idiomatic: An order to the branch secretariats: "Whenever the border defenses have an alert, they are permitted to dispatch troops at discretion; if the matter is not urgent, they shall report by relay.

sentences.zh: 」賑龍慶州懷來縣前歲被兵萬一千八百六十戶糧兩月。

translations.literal: " Huailai County of Longqing Prefecture — eleven thousand eight hundred sixty households afflicted by warfare the previous year — were relieved with two months' grain.
translations.idiomatic: " Huailai County of Longqing Prefecture — 11,860 households afflicted by warfare the previous year — were relieved with 2 months' grain.

sentences.zh: 冀寧路梁世明妻程氏、中興路伯顏妻阿叠的以誌節，大都宛平縣鄭珪以行義，並旌其門。

translations.literal: Cheng, wife of Liang Shiming of Jinang Route, and Adiede, wife of Bayan of Zhongxing Route, for recorded integrity, and Zheng Gui of Wanping County, Dadu, for righteous conduct — all had their gates honored.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng, wife of Liang Shiming of Jinang Route, and Adiede, wife of Bayan of Zhongxing Route, for recorded integrity, and Zheng Gui of Wanping County, Dadu, for righteous conduct — all had their gates honored.

sentences.zh: 賑遼陽行省所居鷹坊戶糧一月。

translations.literal: Hawkery households residing in Liaoyang Branch Secretariat territory were relieved with one month's grain.
translations.idiomatic: Hawkery households residing in Liaoyang Branch Secretariat territory were relieved with 1 month's grain.
